### kalshi-data
## Kalshi Public Data + Bot Feasibility — Findings Brief

**Base URL:** `https://api.elections.kalshi.com/trade-api/v2` (also `external-api.kalshi.com/trade-api/v2`). All market data is no-auth; only orders/portfolio require signed `KALSHI-ACCESS-*` (RSA-PSS) headers.

**Public REST endpoints (no auth, verified):**
- `GET /markets` — list/filter all markets (status, series, event)
- `GET /markets/{ticker}` — single market (prices, volume, OI, last price)
- `GET /markets/{ticker}/orderbook?depth=N` — full bid book, YES+NO sides (no asks; NO bids are the inverted ask). depth 0–100.
- `GET /markets/trades` (also `/markets/{ticker}/trades`) — **every executed trade**: price, count, side (taker), timestamp, paginated
- `GET /series/{s}/markets/{ticker}/candlesticks` — OHLC + volume history (market stats)
- `GET /series/{s}`, `GET /events` — event/series metadata, resolution

**WebSocket (public channels):** `wss://api.elections.kalshi.com/trade-api/ws/v2` — `orderbook_delta` (live book), `ticker` (price), `trade` (live executions). This gives a real-time tape comparable to Polymarket's CLOB feed.

**Rate limits:** token-bucket, tier-based. Basic (default new account): ~**30 req/s** read market data, ~10 req/s writes. Higher tiers (Advanced→Prestige) earned by volume/request. WebSocket avoids polling pressure — prefer it for live tape.

**Individual-trader / leaderboard / position data — the key gap:**
- **Official API: NO.** You can only see *your own* positions/portfolio. No public endpoint exposes other traders' positions, fills, or a leaderboard. Polymarket-style copy-consensus does **not** transfer.
- **Scrapers (kalshi.com social layer):** Kalshi's website *does* surface public profiles, leaderboards, and per-profile open/closed positions + trade history. Apify actors exist: `saswave/kalshi-leaderboard-scraper` (ranks, anonymous-vs-named, value deltas), `saswave/kalshi-profile-scraper` (open_positions, closed_positions, per-ticker trades w/ price/side/timestamp), plus market-data scrapers. These are paid/credit-metered (Apify) and brittle — they depend on Kalshi's frontend/GraphQL staying stable and only cover traders who opted into public profiles (many are anonymous). Reliability: moderate, not free, not guaranteed.

**ToS / legal posture (CFTC-regulated — material risk):**
- Kalshi **Data Terms of Use** restrict data to *personal, non-commercial* use; explicitly **prohibit** using the data to develop software, **train ML/AI**, or redistribute/cache datasets to others **without written consent**.
- API Developer Agreement governs programmatic access; scraping the website beyond the API sits in grayer territory and likely violates site ToS.
- Practical read: a **private, personal, non-redistributed, alert-only** bot on the public REST/WS market data is low-risk and within the spirit of "personal use." Scraping trader profiles for any shared/commercial product, or training models on the data, is squarely against the Data ToS. Keep it personal + paper/alert only (which matches your hard constraints).

**Realistically buildable on FREE data (no scraping needed):** order-book + trade-tape microstructure and cross-venue divergence. Scraped leaderboard data is the *only* path to a Polymarket-style copy signal and is neither free nor ToS-clean — treat as optional/experimental.

**Seed strategy ideas this unlocks:**
1. **Cross-venue divergence/lead-lag (strongest).** Same events on both venues (Kalshi `KXWCGAME`/`KXWCTOTAL` World Cup ↔ Polymarket `fifwc`; elections, crypto, econ). Stream both books, alert when implied-prob gap > threshold; forward-score which venue's price was "right" at resolution → measures price-discovery lead and pseudo-arb edge. Pure free data, forward-testable.
2. **Order-flow imbalance / aggressive-taker tape.** From `trade` + `orderbook_delta`: net taker-signed volume and book-imbalance momentum; alert on bursts, forward-score vs subsequent price move (confound check vs favorite-longshot).
3. **Book-thinness / liquidity-vacuum mispricing.** Flag markets where a small size would move price far (thin book) near events; forward-track reversion.
4. **(Optional, scraper-gated) Kalshi sharp-consensus** — replicate Polymarket copy-consensus from `kalshi-profile-scraper` positions; flagged as paid + ToS-restricted, lower priority.

**Sources:**
- [Kalshi API docs — orderbook](https://docs.kalshi.com/api-reference/market/get-market-orderbook), [get-trades](https://docs.kalshi.com/api-reference/market/get-trades), [rate limits](https://docs.kalshi.com/getting_started/rate_limits)

- [pm.wiki Kalshi API guide](https://pm.wiki/learn/kalshi-api), [QuantVPS order book guide](https://www.quantvps.com/blog/kalshi-order-book-api-endpoints-explained)

### cross-venue
Cross-venue Polymarket↔Kalshi findings brief:

## Feasibility on free data — strong
Both venues expose enough free public data to build a divergence-alert bot:
- **Polymarket:** gamma-api (market metadata, slugs, outcomePrices) + CLOB order book (all public).
- **Kalshi:** `api.elections.kalshi.com/trade-api/v2` — public, no-auth market data, order books, and trade executions (REST + WebSocket). For cross-venue we only need *prices*, not trader positions — so the Kalshi scraping limitation that blocks copy-consensus does NOT apply here. This is the cleanest Kalshi-native angle.

## Matching identical markets (the hard part)
There is no shared ID. Confirmed industry pattern: **human-curated whitelist** mapping `polymarket conditionId ↔ kalshi ticker`. Automated fuzzy matching (team names, dates, strike text) misfires often enough that production bots use curated mappings. Auto-match candidates by normalizing slug/title + event date + outcome, then require human confirmation before a pair goes live. Sports are easiest to auto-pair: Kalshi `KXWCGAME`/`KXWCTOTAL` tickers carry team+date; Polymarket `fifwc-*` slugs do too. Third-party unified APIs exist (Prediction Hunt `/v2/matching-markets`, Dome, pmxt) but those are paid/external — use them only as a reference oracle to validate our free-data mappings, not as the data source.

## Lead-lag — there is a documented "smarter" venue
Peer academic study (Ng, Peng, Tao, Zhou, SSRN 5331995, Apr 2026, 2024-election common contracts): **Polymarket leads Kalshi in price discovery, especially when liquidity/activity is high.** Mechanism: the venue with greater *directional order flow from large trades* leads; net order imbalance predicts subsequent returns. This is directly forward-measurable and is the most interesting signal: when Polymarket moves and Kalshi hasn't yet, Kalshi's stale price is a predictable short-horizon target.

## Divergence magnitudes (forward-trackable)
- Headline/deep-liquidity events: prices within **1–2¢** (no edge).
- Niche/low-liquidity: **5–10¢ gaps persisting hours–days**.
- Documented examples: 2026 recession market 31¢ Kalshi vs 38¢ Polymarket (7¢); 2024 election results diverged 3–8¢ for hours.
- Category skew: Polymarket richer on crypto + international/geopolitical (younger crypto-native base); Kalshi prices US-politics/econ more aggressively. Persistence is driven by real capital-transfer friction between venues.

## Arbitrage → divergence ALERT (no execution)
True arb requires buying YES/NO across venues for <\$1.00 combined. Since we place no trades, this collapses to an *alert*. Costs that gate a real edge (so we threshold alerts above them): Kalshi taker fee `0.07·p·(1−p)` (~1.75¢ at 50¢), Polymarket 0.30% taker / fee-free on world-events; Kalshi ACH settles 1–3 days (capital-rotation drag), Polymarket USDC withdrawals instant.

## Key risks / confounds
1. **Resolution mismatch** — markets that look identical can resolve on different sources/wording/dates (e.g. "Fed cuts 25bps"). This, not pricing, is the dominant false-edge. Every pair needs resolution-text + settlement-date verification before scoring.
2. **Geo/regulatory** — same product is federally-approved on Kalshi yet state-prohibited; ignore for alerts but note.
3. **Stale-quote illusion** — a gap may be one venue's thin book, not a real divergence; require both books to show depth at the quoted price.

## Seed strategy ideas (forward-measurable, alert-only)
1. **Lead-lag follower:** when Polymarket mid moves ≥X¢ on a curated pair and Kalshi hasn't followed within T minutes, alert "Kalshi likely to move toward Polymarket"; score by whether Kalshi converges (sign of Δ vs realized).
2. **Persistent-divergence (pseudo-arb) alert:** combined YES+NO across venues <\$1.00 net of modeled fees on a depth-confirmed pair → alert; forward-score by whether gap closes by resolution.
3. **Category-edge tracker:** run divergence separately for crypto / sports / elections / econ; learn which categories sustain the widest, slowest-closing gaps (hypothesis: niche + crypto).
4. **Order-flow imbalance signal:** from Kalshi public trade tape + Polymarket CLOB, compute net large-trade imbalance per venue; alert when one venue's imbalance predicts the other's repricing (the paper's mechanism).

Sources:

### documented-edges
DOCUMENTED-EDGES RESEARCH BRIEF — prediction-market / sports-betting edges harvestable by a forward-testing alert bot on free Polymarket/Kalshi data.

**1. Favorite-longshot bias (FLB) — REAL, partly harvestable, venue-dependent.** Classic FLB: longshots overbet, favorites underbet. In traditional sportsbooks, betting heavy favorites yields returns near zero (i.e. it cancels the vig but rarely beats it). The most relevant hard data is Kalshi: an analysis of 300k+ contracts found takers lose ~32% on longshots while high-price (favorite) contracts win *more* than break-even and yield *small positive* returns; makers lose ~10%. Polymarket research reports a *reversed* FLB (longshots underpriced) in some samples — so the sign is not stable across venues/event-classes. Verdict: real but mostly already priced; only the favorite tail shows slim positive net-of-vig returns, and it's fragile. Forward-test: tag every signal with entry price band (e.g. >0.85), forward-track AVG(outcome_won − entry_price) per band per venue per category; the bot already stores entry prices, so this is a free overlay on existing signals. Skeptic flag: "bet all favorites" is folklore-adjacent — edge is tiny and category-specific; needs the belief-blind gate.

**2. CLV / sharp money / late line movement — REAL as a *metric*, weak as a standalone signal.** CLV (your entry vs. the price just before resolution/close) is the best-documented proxy for skill; consistently beating the close ⇒ long-run +EV. Reverse line movement (price moves against ticket-majority) is the canonical sharp tell. But "bet late after the move" is documented to be value-destroying — you're betting into an adjusted line. Feasible on free data: Polymarket CLOB + Kalshi order book/trade prints are public, so you can compute true CLV (entry → last-trade-before-close) for every forward signal automatically. Forward-test: log entry mid + closing mid per signal; a strategy is only credible if median CLV > 0 *and* it survives forward outcomes (CLV without resolution is gameable). Skeptic flag: CLV is a *diagnostic*, not itself an alert trigger.

**3. Calendar / liquidity / attention effects — REAL but capacity-limited.** Documented liquidity lifecycle: new contracts launch thin (wide spreads, volatile) → mispricings largest in the discovery phase → liquidity surges into resolution. Tetlock (2008) and others: thin/low-attention markets are less efficient. Edge = catch mispricing during low-attention discovery, exit at maturation. Forward-test: alert when a market is young/low-volume AND consensus-traders take a coherent side; track edge vs. market age/liquidity buckets. Skeptic flag: thin markets = you can't actually fill size; alert-only is fine, "paper" fills must use realistic depth or the edge is illusory.

**4. Resolution/oracle quirks — REAL, asymmetric risk not edge.** Polymarket's UMA optimistic oracle has documented wrong/contested resolutions (1,150+ disputed markets in 2026; a 25%-stake actor settled a $7M market falsely; >half of disputed-market votes from top-10 wallets). This is mostly *tail risk to avoid*, but ambiguous-resolution markets are systematically mispriced pre-dispute. Forward-test: flag markets with vague rules/dispute history; track whether consensus edge degrades there. Treat as a *filter* (suppress alerts on dispute-prone markets), not a money-maker.

**5. Cross-venue divergence / dutching — REAL, fastest-decaying.** Same events on both venues (KXWCGAME World Cup ↔ fifwc, elections, crypto). Persistent 1–5% structural spreads; Polymarket generally *leads* Kalshi (liquidity), so Kalshi lags = forecastable. ~$40M arb profits Apr'24–Apr'25, but windows are seconds–minutes and fee-eroded. Free data: Kalshi REST/WS public order books + Polymarket data-/gamma-/CLOB APIs. Forward-test: poll matched events, log divergence + which venue moved first; measure lead-lag predictability of Kalshi from Polymarket.

**Seed strategies unlocked:**
- **A. Lead-lag follower:** Polymarket consensus/price move → alert on the lagging Kalshi side (forecastable, not just instantaneous arb). Forward-score by Kalshi convergence.
- **B. CLV overlay:** auto-compute closing-line value on every existing portfolio signal; promote only strategies with positive forward CLV *and* outcome edge.
- **C. Favorite-tail + low-attention filter:** restrict copy-consensus alerts to entry>0.80, young/low-liquidity markets, suppressing dispute-prone resolutions.
- **D. Cross-venue divergence monitor:** matched-event spread tracker as a standalone alert + confound check (does consensus edge survive when both venues already agree?).

Sources: [QuantPedia – Systematic Edges](https://quantpedia.com/systematic-edges-in-prediction-markets/), [Kalshi maker/taker economics (GWU)](https://www2.gwu.edu/~forcpgm/2026-001.pdf), [CEPR – Economics of Kalshi](https://cepr.org/voxeu/columns/economics-kalshi-prediction-market), [FLB college sports (ScienceDirect)](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S1062976916000041), [Law of One Price violations (arXiv)](https://arxiv.org/html/2601.01706v1), [Tetlock – Liquidity & Efficiency](https://business.columbia.edu/sites/default/files-efs/pubfiles/3098/Tetlock_SSRN_Liquidity_and_Efficiency.pdf), [UMA oracle manipulation](https://orochi.network/blog/oracle-manipulation-in-polymarket-2025), [VSiN – CLV](https://vsin.com/how-to-bet/the-importance-of-closing-line-value/).

### poly-advanced
## poly-advanced — Advanced Free Polymarket Signals (findings brief)

All endpoints below are **public, unauthenticated, free** (no API key for read-only market data). Confirmed via Polymarket docs.

**Data sources (all free):**
- **CLOB order book** — `GET https://clob.polymarket.com/book?token_id=<clobTokenId>` → full bids/asks arrays (price,size), tick_size, last_trade_price. Multi-level depth. Poll or use the CLOB WebSocket for live book deltas.
- **Price history** — `GET https://clob.polymarket.com/prices-history?market=<clobTokenId>&interval=1h&fidelity=…` (also startTs/endTs; intervals max/1m/1w/1d/6h/1h) → `{history:[{t,p}]}`. This is your momentum/vol time series.
- **Top holders** — `GET https://data-api.polymarket.com/holders?market=<conditionId>` → up to 20 holders per outcome token with proxyWallet, amount, outcomeIndex. Comma-join conditionIds for batch. This is on-chain concentration, free.
- **Trades/activity** — `data-api…/activity?user=<wallet>` (already used) + Gamma `outcomePrices`/resolution. On-chain settlement is ERC-1155 CTF on Polygon, so PolygonScan / The Graph / Bitquery give raw transfers if you want depth beyond the 20-holder cap.

**Feasible signals + forward tests:**

1. **Order-book imbalance (OBI).** Net (bid_size − ask_size)/(total) across top-K levels. Microstructure literature shows OBI has a near-linear, short-horizon (seconds–minutes) predictive link to mid-price moves; multi-level beats best-level. *Forward test:* snapshot book at signal time, score sign(mid-move) over next N minutes; edge = directional hit-rate vs 50%. **Risk:** in thin prediction-market books, "depth" is often a single resting MM — imbalance flips on one cancel; horizon is very short (execution-grade, not hold-to-resolution), so this is a timing overlay, not a standalone alpha.

2. **Price momentum / realized-vol regime** from prices-history. Trend-continuation and vol-expansion signals. *Forward test:* compute signal at t, score realized move to resolution or fixed horizon; edge = AVG(outcome_won − entry). **Risk:** prediction-market prices are bounded [0,1] and mean-revert near resolution; momentum is heavily confounded by genuine news arrival (the line *should* move) — must control for whether you're front-running info or chasing it.

3. **Holder concentration / whale-conviction.** From `/holders`: Herfindahl of top-20 amounts per outcome, and net one-sidedness (top holders all on YES vs split). *Forward test:* at signal, record concentration + side; edge on resolved outcome. **Risk:** 20-holder cap and proxy wallets undercount; concentration correlates with illiquidity (favorite-longshot trap); a whale can be the *loser*. Pair with trader-quality filter.

4. **New-market open mispricing & time-decay.** New markets (Gamma `new`/recent createdAt) have wide spreads and naive priors before sharp money arrives; separately, theta-like drift as time-to-resolution → 0. *Forward test:* tag market age + time-to-resolution bucket on each existing signal; measure realized edge by bucket. **Risk:** wide spread = the "edge" is non-tradable transaction cost; survivorship in which new markets you sampled.

**Trader-quality refinement (highest-value, directly extends your engine):** the leaderboard ranks by PnL/volume, which inflates market-makers and size. From `/activity` per wallet, compute *directional-skill* features: round-trip win-rate on **taker** fills only, avg holding time (filter sub-minute = MM), entry-price-vs-resolution edge, two-sidedness ratio in the same market (you already drop these for consensus — reuse it per-wallet), and Sharpe-like PnL/variance rather than raw PnL. *Forward test:* rank wallets by these, forward-track their fresh signals separately, compare edge vs the raw-leaderboard cohort.

**Seed strategies this unlocks (alert/paper, forward-only):**
- **`skill_weighted`** — re-weight your existing consensus votes by a per-wallet directional-skill score (taker-only, holding-time, two-sidedness) instead of leaderboard rank.
- **`whale_conviction`** — fire when `/holders` shows top-20 concentration + one-sidedness above threshold on a non-longshot price band; forward-score vs blind.
- **`obi_timing` overlay** — don't generate new signals; use book imbalance only to *time entry* on signals another strategy already fired, measuring CLV improvement.
- **`fresh_market_fade`** — fade/confirm new-market opens against sharp-wallet arrival, bucketed by market age and time-to-resolution.

Cross-cutting confound discipline (per your constraints): every strategy must beat **blind-by-price-band** (favorite-longshot), separate **front-running info vs chasing a line that already moved**, and store raw atoms (book snapshot, holder vector, wallet-skill features) so each is replayable over already-collected data.

Sources: [CLOB order book](https://docs.polymarket.com/api-reference/market-data/get-order-book), [prices-history](https://docs.polymarket.com/api-reference/markets/get-prices-history), [top holders](https://docs.polymarket.com/api-reference/core/get-top-holders-for-markets), [Chainstack on-chain/CTF guide](https://chainstack.com/polymarket-api-for-developers/), [OBI/OFI microstructure](https://www.emergentmind.com/topics/order-book-imbalance-obi).

ranked.name: blind-band-benchmark
ranked.why: The denominator the entire portfolio is judged against. Without surplus-over-blind, every raw AVG(won-entry) is contaminated by favorite-longshot base rate and a heavy-favorite strategy games it. Verdict 'viable', edge real. It is the instrument the promotion gate consumes, so it unblocks almost everything else. Risk is thin (band x category x venue) cells, not validity.
ranked.first_step: Define the blind baseline from the UNCONDITIONAL resolved-market universe per (price-band x category x venue), estimate expanding-window/LOO to avoid baseline look-ahead, and add a permanent blind-shadow null check that must score surplus approximately 0.

ranked.name: cluster-robust-dedup
ranked.why: Directly fixes Tue's documented within-match non-independence leak: many outcomes per World Cup match and many variants firing on the same (condition,outcome) are not independent observations. 'Viable', edge real. Cuts alert fatigue AND stops the gate promoting one correlated event as N. Main hazard is over-shrinking effective-N to never-promote.
ranked.first_step: Pre-register cluster key = event_slug with firings nested in (condition,outcome); use wild-cluster bootstrap / t with G-1 dof for few-event slates; keep dedup behind a config flag so conservative N_eff can't silently zero the alert stream.

ranked.name: belief-blind-promotion-gate
ranked.why: MERGES auto-promotion-gate + belief-blind-promotion-gate (duplicate controllers). Converts the forward scoreboard into an automatic, multiplicity-corrected promote/demote decision so the bot only alerts on statistically real surplus. The central irony it must fix: a per-strategy P>0.95 across 10+ replayable variants with optional-stopping inflates family-wise false-promotion far above 5%.
ranked.first_step: Replace fixed 95% bootstrap with an always-valid confidence sequence (alpha-spending/e-process), add FDR across all live+replayed variants, and gate on a minimum distinct-event floor (N_eff >= 25 event_slugs), evaluated only at fixed checkpoints.

ranked.name: correlation-effective-N
ranked.why: 'Viable'. The 10 variants share markets, events and wallets; naive averaging overstates significance and concentrates drawdown. Pairs with cluster-robust-dedup as the statistical backbone of honest promotion. Honest caveat: event-sharing is conflated with informational redundancy, so blunt 1/cluster_size deweighting can discard genuine multi-wallet consensus.
ranked.first_step: Score it on the p-value-calibration arm (corrected p-values vs forward reversion), NOT the near-tautological variance arm; estimate rho_intra from realized outcome correlation among co-open signals, not assumed wallet-overlap.

ranked.name: depth-confirmed-dutch-divergence-alert
ranked.why: The ONLY market-edge strategy rated 'viable'. A depth-confirmed, resolution-matched YES-here/NO-there book under $1.00 net of fees is a structural mispricing sustained by real capital-transfer friction (ACH delay, KYC, geo). Make-or-break is resolution concordance (draw/ET/penalties/void rules) and true multi-level depth. Expect it to refute most 'persistent niche' gaps and certify only a clean tail.
ranked.first_step: Pre-register the resolution-concordance gate (settlement source, tie/draw/ET/void, settlement date) BEFORE resolution; never exclude pairs post-hoc on outcome; score ONLY hold-to-resolution realized dutch P&L (gap half-life is diagnostic) on depth summed across levels net of conservative fees.

ranked.name: cross-venue-resolution-truth
ranked.why: MERGES xvenue-pair-registry-and-dual-feed. The shared PM<->Kalshi pair table + dual feed + resolution reconciler that every cross-venue strategy depends on, and itself the confound FILTER against the #1 cross-venue false edge (resolve-different). 'Viable' but payoff is contingent on the downstream family, and it may REVEAL the clean-pair divergence family is dead (efficient near-arb).
ranked.first_step: Ship only the thin sports slice first (Kalshi KXWCGAME/KXWCTOTAL team+date vs PM fifwc-* slugs) with a human-spot-checked whitelist (NO paid oracle - free-data constraint); attach an explicit kill-criterion to retire the family if clean-pair divergence shows no forward edge over M resolutions.

ranked.name: tight-coherence-cluster
ranked.why: Param-only drop-in (max_price_std=0.04, min_backers=4, max_opposers=0, max_age=720). A dense, unopposed cluster of distinct sharps is plausibly a stronger info event than 'strict'. Costs nothing to forward-track now. Main risk: fires too rarely to ever reach N>=30, leaving it INDETERMINATE-BY-POWER and tempting post-hoc relaxation (p-hacking).
ranked.first_step: Add the variant to the silent forward portfolio with the four thresholds PRE-REGISTERED and a no-relaxation rule; require it to beat both strict and blind-by-band by a preset effect floor with FDR across variants before any promotion.

ranked.name: clv-capture-overlay
ranked.why: CLV is the best-documented leading skill proxy and computable here since both tapes are public; it can kill losing strategies and confirm winners many resolutions before slow outcome scoring, and suppress entries after the line already moved. Trap: last-trade-before-resolution closing_mid is near-collinear with the outcome, so it is NOT an independent second confirmation.
ranked.first_step: Redefine CLV against a FIXED reference (price move over a fixed post-entry horizon, or game-start canonical close), add a min book-depth filter before logging mids, and use it as a variance-reduced EARLY estimate + entry-suppression gate, keeping AVG(won-entry) as the sole banking metric.

ranked.name: atom-replay-cli
ranked.why: Realizes the 'no-backtest superpower': re-score any new StrategyDef param-set over stored point-in-time observed_votes atoms instantly, and widen capture to ALL observed books (not just fired signals) to kill survivorship bias. Pure leverage. Danger: scoring many param-sets over one shared event-correlated history manufactures false surplus>0 winners; replay must stay a prefilter, never forward proof.
ranked.first_step: Build the CLI with the binding gate strictly forward-only; add registered-param-count FDR, event-clustered CIs, FLB-neutral surplus, disjoint-window calibration (replay window A predicts forward window B), and flag any strategy looser than the historical filter as survivorship-unsafe.

ranked.name: kelly-paper-pnl
ranked.why: Replaces flat AVG(won-entry) with fractional-Kelly log-bankroll so a strategy only 'earns' by compounding, not by lucky high-variance longshots. Honest economic objective. Confound: using full-sample edge as p_hat self-fulfills (in-sample overperformers get more capital); correlated simultaneous signals break Kelly independence.
ranked.first_step: Make p_hat strictly causal (expanding-window, only signals resolved before each timestamp), add a per-resolution-window correlated-exposure cap, and report log-growth ALONGSIDE flat edge and blind-by-band Kelly, not as a silent replacement.

ranked.name: wallet-skill-universe
ranked.why: MERGES skill-weighted-consensus. Selects/weights the tracked universe by forward-measured directional CONTRIBUTION edge instead of raw leaderboard PnL/volume (which inflates MMs and size), and EXPANDS below the top-N cutoff to surface skilled-but-unranked wallets the copy-crowd hasn't priced. Core confound: contribution_edge is itself FLB-contaminated, so 'skill universe' risks being a 'backs-favorites universe'.
ranked.first_step: Redefine contribution_edge as surplus over a per-price FLB-adjusted blind baseline, compute strictly walk-forward with frozen weights + min-K + shrink-to-zero, and run as a shadow universe with per-event clustered CIs for weeks before promotion.

ranked.name: elite-fresh-favorite-band
ranked.why: Param-only (require_elite, band 0.80-0.97, max_age=180). Pairs the one FLB region with documented slim-positive net returns with a fresh elite entry. Honest stance baked in: most raw return is structural FLB; only the increment over a BLIND favorite-band baseline is real edge. Risk: 'elite' status is volume/variance-inflated, and mean_price scoring overstates realizable edge (alert fires after the elite's fill moved the line).
ranked.first_step: Forward-track with the decisive control = beat a blind buy-every-in-band baseline; add a second scoring leg pricing entry at the post-alert CLOB ask, and pre-register a resolved-N floor before any 'beats blind-fav' claim.

ranked.name: pm-leads-kalshi-leadlag-follower
ranked.why: Documented (SSRN 5331995): Polymarket leads Kalshi via directional order flow; settlement friction means the venues don't instantly arb to parity. When PM mid moves >=X and Kalshi hasn't followed, the stale Kalshi side is a forecastable target. Confound: buying after PM's move at Kalshi's spread-crossed price pays an already-efficient price, so convergence hit-rate looks like edge even when net resolution edge is zero.
ranked.first_step: Trigger and score on the EXECUTABLE Kalshi price (ask for longs, bid for shorts) + fees, never mid; store the inside quote in replay atoms; require the RESOLUTION-edge test (not convergence) to clear the bar on confirmed mirrored pairs, bucketed by liquidity.

ranked.name: fresh-open-mispricing
ranked.why: Discovery-phase edge: gate consensus to YOUNG markets (createdAt age) where spreads are wide and the prior is naive before sharp money arrives - distinct from the existing fresh2h FILL-recency knob. Dominant risk: wide discovery spreads make mid/last entry unattainable, so the 'edge' can be pure transaction cost, compounded by young-market longshot skew and thin double-conditioned cells.
ranked.first_step: Make controls the scoring rule: walk the live CLOB /book for a realistic $100-500 clip at signal time and use that VWAP as entry; benchmark surplus over a blind-young-by-band baseline; lock a min-N gate per age x TTR bucket and require monotonicity in youth.

ranked.name: regime-segment-router
ranked.why: Route alert attention to the best variant WITHIN each {sports}x{price-band}x{age} segment so a globally-mediocre variant that dominates a niche still surfaces. Pooling hides conditional edges. But argmax-edge-per-segment over a grid x 10 variants is a multiple-comparisons machine; with small n_g the winner is the luckiest cell and 'routed > best-global' is mechanically inflated.
ranked.first_step: Pre-register a SMALL fixed segment grid; require each routed cell to clear a power floor + FDR across cells x variants, beat its own-band blind baseline, pass a split-half stability check, and be scored strictly walk-forward OOS.

ranked.name: score-to-hitrate-calibration
ranked.why: Isotonic/logistic map from composite score to realized P(won) on a rolling past-only window, attaching calibrated confidence + fractional-Kelly stake (creates no new signal). Improves bankroll geometry. Confound: the map can simply relearn FLB base rates and present them as confidence; and if base edge is <=0, Kelly correctly sizes to ~0 and the overlay delivers nothing.
ranked.first_step: Demote to a DIAGNOSTIC first - ship reliability diagram / Brier / ECE on trailing-fit OOS signals; constrain to 1-D monotone isotonic on score; gate any real stake on proven-positive base edge + OOS ECE improvement + <=1/4 Kelly beating flat.

ranked.name: theta-drift-ttr-gate
ranked.why: Forward-LEARN the time-to-resolution window where copy-edge survives instead of assuming a horizon. Cheap overlay on stored signals. But TTR is mechanically confounded with price level (near resolution prices pin to 0/1) and market-type mix, so any 'interior sweet-spot' can be a pure FLB/price-level artifact - exactly the efficiency-lifecycle confound it cites.
ranked.first_step: Pre-register a small fixed set of ~3 TTR bands; require the candidate band to beat all-TTR OOS AND still beat after matching on entry-price level + category, plus a per-bucket power floor with multiple-testing correction; keep it a read-only diagnostic until then.

ranked.name: xvenue-agreement-confound-gate
ranked.why: Defensive overlay: when PM consensus and independent Kalshi price already agree, the info is likely priced (two venues concur); when Kalshi lags/disagrees the signal is more likely genuinely new. Refines an existing money-maker rather than inventing one. Confound: disagreement is symmetric and adverse-selection-prone - the disagree bucket may underperform because PM is WRONG, not because it leads; plus resolution-basis masquerading as mispricing.
ranked.first_step: Demote from active gate to a passive logged atom (cross-venue gap+sign on every matched signal); empirically measure each bucket's forward edge and establish per-category lead-lag direction BEFORE gating; flag large gaps as basis-suspect.

ranked.name: mm-holding-time-filter
ranked.why: Global anti-MM filter catching cross-market two-sided wallets that survive the current same-market/same-cycle drop. Plausibly sharpens signal-to-noise. But the consensus is already NET-directional so excluding balanced MM flow is near-neutral on the net vote (~0 sharpening), and a directional-PnL leaderboard rarely contains genuine cross-market MMs, so contamination may be negligible.
ranked.first_step: Enforce point-in-time MM scoring (use only each wallet's activity up to the signal cycle); FIRST report the contamination magnitude (votes dropped per signal) to confirm there is anything to clean before claiming improvement.

ranked.name: favorite-tail-harvest
ranked.why: Param-only band (0.85-0.96, non-sports). HONEST: the whole 'edge' is the favorite-longshot bias, a property of the PRICE band - if it exists it is fully captured by blind-by-band betting and the consensus adds nothing. Best treated as a measurement-only null-probe to quantify FLB per category, NOT a promotable edge. Likely indeterminate as alpha.
ranked.first_step: Reframe as a labeled FLB measurement probe per band/category (blind-by-band, no consensus); only consider promotion if consensus beats blind-by-band by more than modeled fees per category on adequate N - expect a null.

ranked.name: category-divergence-halflife-tracker
ranked.why: Param/bucketing layer (once the feed exists) learning which categories sustain widest/slowest gaps - hypothesis PM sharper on crypto/geopolitics, Kalshi on US-politics/econ. Cheap routing table. Confound: largest slowest gaps are disproportionately NON-fungible pairs (different resolution terms), so 'edge concentration' selects contract differences, not mispricing; post-hoc widest-category picking inflates false positives.
ranked.first_step: Build on top of the cross-venue feed; promote categories on realized downstream RESOLUTION edge only (never raw divergence size/half-life), after a fungibility pre-screen + per-bucket min-N with multiple-comparison correction.

ranked.name: whale-conviction
ranked.why: Orthogonal-ish on-chain conviction from /holders: fire when top-20 holders are concentrated (Herfindahl) AND one-sided on a non-longshot band. Confound: one-sidedness is mechanically collinear with price (favored side attracts heavy holders) so it risks re-detecting the efficient line; Herfindahl is collinear with illiquidity/staleness; and leaderboard whales ARE often the concentrated holders, so it may not be orthogonal to the existing copy engine.
ranked.first_step: Add a liquidity/volume floor, weight Herfindahl by USDC (shares x price), residualize one-sidedness on price within band, and gate promotion on beating BOTH band-blind AND a copy-consensus-controlled stratum.

ranked.name: agreement-of-strategies
ranked.why: Fire a meta-signal only when >=k of the 10 variants independently agree on the same (condition,outcome), isolating the lever-robust core. Confound: agreement_k is collinear with raw consensus strength (same vote pile, monotone-relaxed thresholds) and with partition membership (longshot/favorite, sports/nonsports are DISJOINT voters), so high-k just selects the strongest most-obvious public consensus - likely already priced and partly a relabeled threshold sweep.
ranked.first_step: Pre-register a test that regresses realized edge on k with raw consensus strength held fixed within price/category partition - count only if k adds edge BEYOND strength; reframe the win metric to risk-adjusted (edge per unit variance).

ranked.name: pnl-conviction-weight
ranked.why: WeightMode::Conviction scoring consensus by size x PnL/Sharpe instead of plain trader count (size_usd is already on every atom but ignored). Verdict marginal, edge_is_real FALSE: whale size concentrates on near-certain favorites, so a positive AVG(won-mean_price) largely reflects the favorite tilt, not skill. Leakage trap: stored atoms lack the volume/period for a Sharpe proxy, so the 'fast retroactive replay' would need CURRENT leaderboard data = look-ahead.
ranked.first_step: Drive the weight primarily off size (pnl/rank only as tie-break, drop Sharpe framing), residualize against mean_price / run within fixed bands, snapshot conviction inputs into the atom at capture time, and require beating BOTH the existing Dollars mode AND blind-by-band.

ranked.name: thompson-attention-allocator
ranked.why: Allocate the scarce daily alert budget across variants by Thompson sampling with an exploration floor. Edge_is_real FALSE per the null prior: if most variants are near-zero edge (the default until one certifies), Thompson optimally allocates among indistinguishable zero-edge arms - a perfect optimizer over nothing, and low cumulative-regret merely reflects no best arm to miss.
ranked.first_step: Reframe as harmless infra: continuous/Gaussian-reward bandit on the real edge metric, time-discounting for non-stationarity, and gate divergence-from-uniform behind a min resolved-N power threshold so below it the policy is provably no worse than uniform.

ranked.name: scraper-fidelity-canary
ranked.why: Reliability gate for the (paid, ToS-gray, brittle) Kalshi scraped-position family: reconcile scraped position deltas against the free public trade tape. Edge_is_real FALSE as specified: the tape carries NO wallet identity, so per-delta 'matching print exists' can't distinguish a fresh scraped position from a coincidental same-size print - match-rate is confounded by background trade density. Only worth building if a scraped strategy first shows standalone leak-free edge.
ranked.first_step: Ship only the deterministic identity-free half (snapshot freshness/latency, coverage delta, schema-break detection, the one-directional rule: position delta with ZERO tape activity = RED); gate further work on a scraped strategy proving standalone forward edge first.

ranked.name: obi-entry-timing-overlay
ranked.why: Pure entry-timing overlay (no new signal): on a fired signal, compute multi-level CLOB OBI and test whether OBI-aligned entries realize better CLV over minutes. Edge_is_real FALSE: thin PM books make OBI near-noise/spoofable (one cancel flips sign), so the documented deep-market predictivity likely doesn't transfer, and partition-by-alignment confounds timing with underlying signal quality.
ranked.first_step: Ship as a pure diagnostic with a within-signal counterfactual (does sign(OBI) predict achievable mid improvement over [T,T+N]) behind a min book-depth filter; only promote to a 'wait' recommendation if the depth-filtered hit-rate clears 50% OOS.

ranked.name: kalshi-taker-flow-momentum
ranked.why: Closest Kalshi-native substitute for the missing copy-signal: net taker-signed aggression precedes lagged maker re-quoting in thin books. Edge_is_real FALSE: in thin prediction markets one-sided bursts are overwhelmingly news-driven, so by alert time the move is justified and priced - you chase, not front-run, eaten further by spread + Kalshi taker fees.
ranked.first_step: Make short-horizon continuation/CLV the PRIMARY metric (demote resolution edge); add a lagged-entry control (enter 5m later - surviving edge = real repricing capture), a cross-venue news-coincidence filter, and a real spread haircut on low-liquidity markets only.

ranked.name: kalshi-large-print-follow
ranked.why: Follow a single aggressive print far above rolling-median size as a proxy for informed conviction (the only public who-is-confident signal since Kalshi hides positions). Edge_is_real FALSE: attainable version eaten by spread + taker fees and faster maker repricing; scoring at the whale's own fill is look-ahead-flavored; print size correlates with illiquid longshots.
ranked.first_step: Score at the ATTAINABLE post-print fill (next ask/mid after realistic latency) minus fees + half-spread, and require the band-relative CONTINUATION edge (not the print's own entry) to survive forward vs blind-by-band.

ranked.name: kalshi-liquidity-vacuum-reversion
ranked.why: Fade thinness-driven price spikes that revert once liquidity arrives. Edge_is_real FALSE: bid-ask bounce on thin books makes mid-reversion appear automatically and uncapturably, the spread you must cross likely exceeds the reversion, and genuine news moves (permanent) get faded into losses.
ranked.first_step: Score on the TRADE TAPE not mid (kills the bounce artifact); define edge as executable reversion NET of the crossed spread against modeled depth; add an event-window filter stripping in-game/news windows; promote only if net-of-spread fade beats blind-by-band on N resolved.

ranked.name: kalshi-price-flow-divergence
ranked.why: Reverse-line-movement analog: bet the aggressive-taker side when mid drifts the other way. Edge_is_real FALSE: without identity you can't tell sharp pressure from retail momentum that makers rationally fade, so the signal is plausibly the INVERSE of the claimed edge; thin-book divergence is dominated by stale one-lot quotes.
ranked.first_step: Forward-track SILENTLY (never alert) on flagship-liquid markets with a hard depth/notional floor; ALSO forward-track the opposite price-following variant in the same harness and let the tape arbitrate the sign before any belief.

ranked.name: kalshi-book-imbalance-obi
ranked.why: Multi-level OBI as a short-horizon mid-move predictor (YES bid book + inverted NO book). Edge_is_real FALSE: thin-book OBI is MM inventory artifact, and Kalshi event spreads (several cents) exceed any plausible OBI-timing gain, so mid-scoring manufactures a phantom that vanishes against tradeable bid/ask. Benefit is unharvestable without order placement, which is barred.
ranked.first_step: Run as a null-calibrated research probe only: store top-K book atoms, test forward predictivity at 1/5/15m vs a shuffle null scored strictly against EXECUTABLE bid/ask net of spread; never alert on it.

ranked.name: xvenue-orderflow-imbalance-lead
ranked.why: Operationalizes SSRN directly: the venue with greater large-trade taker imbalance leads the other's repricing. High effort. Dominant confound: genuine-information co-movement - real news moves BOTH venues so a raw lead-lag hit-rate >50% is expected with zero exploitable edge; the news control is imperfect and the residual pure-flow sample may be too small/fast; PM taker side must be inferred.
ranked.first_step: Restrict to medium-liquidity markets; make the news-vs-flow split a HARD gate (report edge only on the no-prior-price-jump pure-flow subset), score paper entry at the next post-signal venue-B mid, and beat blind-by-band within that subset.

ranked.name: kalshi-spread-compression-breakout
ranked.why: High effort. Spread tightening + concurrent OBI tilt as a leading directional signal. Edge_is_real FALSE: the OBI-matched control will most likely show compression adds ~nothing over OBI alone, collapsing it to a generic studied/exploited/fragile OBI-momentum bet; plus reverse causality (the move causes the compression) and mid-to-mid scoring ignoring spread+fees.
ranked.first_step: Make the OBI-matched control the PRIMARY kill switch (promote only if compression-conditioned hit-rate beats OBI-matched samples by a preset margin), require the OBI tilt to PREDATE compression, and score realized fillable PnL net of spread+fees above a liquidity floor.

themes: Honesty/measurement infra is the real near-term ROI, not new market signals. The five 'viable' verdicts are all accounting instruments (blind-band-benchmark, cluster-robust-dedup, correlation-effective-N, cross-venue-resolution-truth, depth-confirmed-dutch). Build the denominator + the promotion gate first; almost every 'edge' is only knowable through them.

Favorite-longshot bias is the universal confound. Nearly every strategy that scores AVG(outcome_won - entry_price) can be gamed by loading favorites. Surplus-over-blind-by-band is the single control that recurs in 20+ entries; until it exists, no edge claim is interpretable.

Multiple-comparisons / optional-stopping is the second systemic leak. Ten live variants + arbitrarily-many replayed param-sets + per-segment argmax all inflate family-wise false-promotion far above nominal. Every promotion-adjacent strategy needs FDR + always-valid confidence sequences + a distinct-EVENT (not raw-signal) N floor.

Mid-price scoring is a phantom-edge generator across microstructure and cross-venue. Spreads, especially on thin Kalshi books, exceed almost any timing gain; the alert/paper-only constraint means anything whose payoff is sub-spread execution timing is structurally unharvestable. Score everything at executable bid/ask net of fees.

Cross-venue's make-or-break is resolution concordance, not divergence magnitude. The widest, most persistent gaps are disproportionately non-fungible contracts (draw/ET/penalties/void rules). The infra that filters mismatch may REVEAL the divergence family is mostly dead rather than unlock it - so it must carry an explicit kill-criterion.

Order-flow / news co-movement confound dominates every lead-lag and taker-flow idea (PM and Kalshi). Raw hit-rate >50% is expected with zero exploitable edge because news moves everything; only the news-stripped, executable-priced residual counts, and it is usually small and fast.

Many surviving 'edges' are honestly INDETERMINATE-BY-POWER, mirroring the Foresight arc: real-but-tiny effects whose CIs straddle break-even on achievable N. The correct posture is pre-registered floors + silent forward-tracking, not promotion.

Kalshi-native and scraped families are the weakest tier: no public positions means copy-consensus doesn't transfer, microstructure is unharvestable under paper-only, and scraping is paid/ToS-gray/identity-blind. Lean cross-venue (free, mirrored World Cup markets) instead of Kalshi-solo.
top_recommendations: Build blind-band-benchmark FIRST (surplus-over-blind per price-band x category x venue, expanding-window baseline + permanent blind-shadow null check). It is the denominator the whole portfolio is judged against and unblocks every other edge claim.

Ship the statistical backbone together: cluster-robust-dedup (cluster=event_slug, fixes Tue's within-match leak) + correlation-effective-N (p-value-calibration arm) + a single merged belief-blind promotion gate using an always-valid confidence sequence + FDR across all live and replayed variants + a distinct-EVENT N floor.

Add the three param-only consensus variants to the silent forward portfolio NOW with pre-registered thresholds and a no-relaxation rule: tight-coherence-cluster, elite-fresh-favorite-band, favorite-tail-harvest (the last as an FLB measurement probe, not a promotable edge).

Build atom-replay-cli to realize the no-backtest superpower - re-score new param-sets over stored point-in-time atoms - but keep the binding gate forward-only and widen capture to ALL observed books to kill survivorship bias.

Pursue cross-venue as the highest-conviction NEW market edge via the thin slice: cross-venue-resolution-truth (free human-spot-checked World Cup pair whitelist, NO paid oracle) feeding depth-confirmed-dutch-divergence-alert, with a pre-registered concordance gate, hold-to-resolution-only scoring, and an explicit family kill-criterion.

Wire clv-capture-overlay as a variance-reduced EARLY skill estimate and entry-suppression gate (against a FIXED reference horizon, NOT last-trade-before-resolution), to kill losing strategies many resolutions before slow outcomes do - keeping AVG(won-entry) as the sole banking metric.

Reframe wallet-skill-universe / kelly-paper-pnl / score-to-hitrate-calibration as causal-only, FLB-netted, shadow-mode overlays - real improvements to input quality and bankroll geometry, but never promoted on in-sample edge.

Deprioritize and do NOT alert on the Kalshi-native microstructure family and scraped family; if touched, run them as silent null-calibrated probes scored at executable bid/ask, since their benefit is unharvestable under the alert/paper-only constraint.
quick_wins: tight-coherence-cluster: param-only variant (max_price_std=0.04, min_backers=4, max_opposers=0, max_age_mins=720) - add to silent forward portfolio today with the four thresholds pre-registered and a forbid-post-hoc-relaxation rule.

elite-fresh-favorite-band: param-only (require_elite=true, price_band=0.80-0.97, max_age_mins=180) - forward-track with the decisive control being beat-blind-favorite-band, plus a post-alert-ask realizability leg.

favorite-tail-harvest: param-only band (0.85-0.96, non-sports) added as a labeled FLB MEASUREMENT probe (quantify the bias per category), explicitly not a promotable edge - expect it to collapse to blind-by-band.

Add a blind-by-band shadow strategy to the portfolio immediately as the permanent null/self-validation arm (must score surplus approximately 0); near-zero effort and it validates every other strategy's surplus going forward.

Start logging the executable inside quote (bid/ask), not just mid, into observed_votes atoms now - costs nothing extra at capture but is required for every realizability and CLV check later and cannot be back-filled.

detail.name: skill-weighted-consensus
detail.mechanism: Replace the rank-only quality_weight with a per-wallet DIRECTIONAL-SKILL score and re-weight/gate consensus votes by it. Leaderboard rank is driven by raw PnL and volume, which rewards size and market-making, not directional taker skill. Surfacing wallets that are skilled but under-ranked exposes fresh picks the copy-crowd (which anchors on rank) hasn't yet pushed into the price.
detail.edge_source: Leaderboard rank conflates size/MM volume with skill; the copy-trading crowd follows rank, so genuinely skilled-but-unranked wallets are under-followed and their fresh entries are not yet priced in. Skill features are computed purely from each wallet's pre-signal history, so no look-ahead.
detail.forward_test: New forward-tracked strategy 'skill_weighted' run alongside the existing 10. Metric: edge = AVG(outcome_won - mean_price) over resolved signals. Must beat (a) 'strict' on the overlapping signal set, (b) blind-by-price-band baseline, and (c) the same rule using rank-weight instead of skill-weight (isolates that skill, not just selection, adds value).
detail.confounds: Skill estimates are noisy regression-to-mean magnets: with hundreds of wallets, top past-win-rate wallets are partly lucky (multiple-testing selection bias), so the re-weight may add noise, not signal, and forward volume likely can't separate it from rank-weight (underpowered). Also the premise that the copy-crowd anchors only on rank is questionable folklore — public smart-money-tracking tools already surface profitable individual wallets, so "skilled-but-unranked = unfollowed/unpriced" may already be arbitraged.
detail.fix: (1) Base the skill score on entry-price-vs-resolution EDGE only, dropping raw win-rate to de-confound favorite-longshot. (2) To actually realize the stated mechanism, EXPAND the tracked-wallet universe below the top-N rank cutoff (discover skilled-but-unranked wallets) rather than only re-weighting the existing top-N — otherwise rename it honestly as a within-set re-weight. (3) Pre-register the minimum resolved-signal N and an effect-size floor for the skill-vs-rank arm so it gates on power, not on a CI straddling break-even.

detail.name: mm-holding-time-filter
detail.mechanism: Global anti-market-maker filter. The current engine only drops wallets that are two-sided within the SAME market in the SAME cycle; a real MM is two-sided ACROSS many markets and flips within minutes, so it looks one-sided in any single snapshot and survives. Excluding that liquidity-provision flow (information-free, mean-zero by construction) tightens the directional consensus.
detail.edge_source: Same-market/same-cycle two-sidedness misses cross-market MMs whose neutral quotes carry no directional info; the posted line already reflects those quotes as neutral, so removing them sharpens our signal-to-noise without fighting priced information.
detail.forward_test: Forward-track 'mm_filtered' separately; metric edge = AVG(outcome_won - mean_price). Compare vs 'strict' on the same cycles, and log signal-churn (how many signals appear/disappear). Credible only if edge improves AND survives blind-by-band; a null result still de-risks the consensus by quantifying MM contamination.
detail.confounds: The consensus is NET-directional and MM flow is balanced by construction, so excluding it is near-neutral on the net vote — the "sharpening" is plausibly ~0. Compounding this, the tracked wallets are a directional-PnL leaderboard where genuine cross-market MMs rarely appear, so the contamination being filtered may be negligible to begin with.
detail.fix: Enforce point-in-time MM-scoring (compute the global two-sided/holding-time/churn score using ONLY each wallet's activity up to the signal cycle — never full history — to kill look-ahead leakage). Pre-register tau1/tau2 before the forward run. First report the contamination magnitude (how many votes the filter actually drops per signal) to confirm there is anything to clean; then require the mm_filtered edge to beat strict AND survive blind-by-band on independent cycle blocks before claiming improvement.

detail.name: pnl-conviction-weight
detail.mechanism: Add a WeightMode::Conviction that scores consensus by SMART-MONEY size-and-PnL weight instead of plain trader count: weight each backer by (normalized realized PnL / Sharpe proxy) x log(size_usd of the fill). size_usd is already on every vote/atom but the current scorer ignores it. A $50k entry by a high-Sharpe wallet should outweigh a $50 tail-bettor.
detail.edge_source: Plain trader-count weights a tiny longshot bet equal to a large sharp position; large directional taker size is the documented order-flow-imbalance lead signal. Markets aggregate volume but our consensus currently throws away who-sized-what, so conviction weighting recovers priced-but-discarded information rather than inventing a new edge.
detail.forward_test: Forward-track 'conviction' strategy; metric edge = AVG(outcome_won - mean_price). MUST beat blind-by-price-band (size correlates with favorites -> the dominant confound here) and beat 'strict'. Because it is replayable, also score it retroactively over all stored atoms for a faster read.
detail.confounds: Favorite-longshot: whale size concentrates on near-certain favorites, so a positive AVG(won - mean_price) will largely reflect the favorite tilt, not smart-money skill. The strategy does name "beat blind-by-price-band" as the control, which is the right guard. Secondary leakage risk: the stored atoms (consensus_cycle.rs line 254-262) snapshot only wallet/rank/pnl/price/size_usd/ts — NOT the volume/period needed for a Sharpe proxy. So the advertised "retroactive replay over stored atoms for a faster read" cannot compute the headline weight without re-fetching CURRENT leaderboard volume = look-ahead leakage; the clean forward-track is fine, the fast retroactive read is not.
detail.fix: (1) Pre-register that it must beat BOTH the existing Dollars mode AND blind-by-price-band — proving marginal value over the size-weighting that already ships, not just over Count. (2) Snapshot the conviction inputs (volume, period PnL) INTO the atom at capture time so retroactive replay is leakage-free; otherwise restrict scoring to forward-track only. (3) Residualize the conviction weight against mean_price (or run within fixed price bands) so the test cannot pass merely by rediscovering favorites. (4) Drop the "Sharpe" framing — drive the weight primarily off size, using pnl/rank only as a tie-break, to avoid triple-counting the survivorship-biased PnL already in selection + quality.

detail.name: tight-coherence-cluster
detail.mechanism: Param-only variant demanding a denser, tighter-agreeing sharp cluster than 'strict' tolerates: max_price_std=0.04, min_backers=4, max_opposers=0, max_age_mins=720. Hypothesis: many distinct sharps entering inside a narrow price window with zero opposition is a genuine information event, not slow drift or noise.
detail.edge_source: The market sees aggregate volume, not the distinct-wallet price agreement; a tight, unopposed cluster of independent sharps is stronger evidence than 'strict' encodes, and that cross-wallet coherence is not directly observable in the order book.
detail.forward_test: Forward-track 'tight_cluster'; metric edge = AVG(outcome_won - mean_price). Must beat 'strict', 'loose', and blind-by-band. Watch volume: if it fires too rarely to resolve N>=30 in a reasonable window, relax thresholds one notch.
detail.confounds: Firing rate too low to resolve N>=30 in any reasonable window → power-starved, indistinguishable from 'strict' at significance; compounded by the post-hoc "relax one notch" clause (multiple-comparisons / p-hacking across an already-10-deep portfolio) and the fact that the base strategy it refines isn't itself a proven edge.
detail.fix: Pre-register the four thresholds and the promotion gate before any resolution; forbid post-hoc relaxation — if N<30 it stays INDETERMINATE, you do NOT loosen and re-test. Require it to beat BOTH 'strict' and blind-by-band by a pre-set effect floor with an FDR correction across the full portfolio of variants. Frame it as a labeled diagnostic on collected atoms rather than a new promotable strategy until the base 'strict' edge is itself certified.

detail.name: elite-fresh-favorite-band
detail.mechanism: Param-only variant pairing the one FLB region with documented positive net returns (the favorite tail) with a fresh elite-sharp entry: require_elite=true, price_band=(0.80,0.97), max_age_mins=180. Tests whether an elite wallet entering a favorite during the discovery window adds an information event on top of the structural favorite-tail edge.
detail.edge_source: Favorite-tail is the documented FLB region with slim positive net-of-vig returns; gating on a FRESH ELITE entry targets the moment before the line fully tightens. Honest stance: most of the raw return is the structural FLB (already known) — the forward test isolates whether elite-freshness adds anything beyond it.
detail.forward_test: Forward-track 'elite_fresh_fav'; metric edge = AVG(outcome_won - mean_price). The decisive confound check: it must beat a BLIND favorite-band baseline (buy every signal with mean_price in [0.80,0.97]); only the increment over blind-favorite is real edge, not the FLB itself.
detail.confounds: Even with FLB differenced out, the residual elite-freshness signal must clear two traps: (1) PnL-ranked leaderboard "elite" status is volume/variance-inflated, so eliteness may just proxy large wallets that naturally appear on big favorite markets; and (2) scoring against mean_price overstates realizable edge because the alert fires AFTER the elite's fill has already moved the line — a real copier pays worse, so absolute edge is inflated (only the relative increment survives).
detail.fix: Raise N and add a realizability leg: relax the conjunction (widen max_age and/or elite_rank) and pool elite-fresh-fav into a single larger meta-comparison rather than a thin standalone cell; pre-register a minimum resolved-signal floor and a day-block/sequential gate before any "beats blind-fav" claim; and add a second scoring leg that prices entry at the post-alert CLOB ask (not the elite's fill) so the certified edge is achievable, not inflated.

detail.name: score-to-hitrate-calibration
detail.mechanism: Calibration + conviction-sizing overlay (creates no new signals). Fit a monotone isotonic/logistic map from the existing composite score (plus net_count, coherence, freshness, price_band) to realized P(outcome_won) using ALREADY-RESOLVED forward signals on a rolling past-only window. Then attach a calibrated confidence and a fractional-Kelly paper stake to every alert.
detail.edge_source: The composite score is an uncalibrated ranking, not a probability; calibrating it lets sizing concentrate on the score/price bands where consensus actually beats the line and shrink where it does not. It improves bankroll geometry on existing signals rather than claiming new alpha — and the rolling past-only fit guarantees no leakage.
detail.forward_test: On out-of-sample resolved signals: (1) reliability diagram / Brier score / ECE of calibrated_p vs outcome_won; (2) compare cumulative log-growth and total edge of Kelly-sized vs flat-staked over the SAME signal stream. Win = better calibration AND higher risk-adjusted log-growth, with the fit always trailing the scoring date.
detail.confounds: The calibration map can simply relearn favorite-longshot base rates (high score clusters on favorites that win more) and present that as "confidence"; only the calibrated_p-vs-price (edge) construction guards against it, and that guard is exactly where small-N noise bites hardest. Separately, "edge" measured as AVG(outcome_won - entry_price) on the base signals may already be ≤0, in which case Kelly correctly sizes to ~0 and the overlay delivers nothing.
detail.fix: Demote from a sizing driver to a DIAGNOSTIC first: ship reliability diagram / Brier / ECE on out-of-sample trailing-fit signals as a calibration monitor, and run Kelly-vs-flat only in SHADOW. Constrain overfit — use 1-D monotone isotonic on score (or at most score x price_band bins with ≥50 resolved samples/bin), not a free multi-feature fit. Gate any real paper-stake adoption on: (a) base consensus edge proven positive and stable, (b) out-of-sample ECE improvement, AND (c) heavily shrunk fractional Kelly (≤1/4) winning flat on out-of-sample log-growth. Otherwise stay flat.

detail.name: favorite-tail-harvest
detail.mechanism: Restrict consensus alerts to a tight favorite TAIL band (mean entry 0.85-0.96, excluding 0.97+ where there is no room above the line) on NON-sports markets, where the documented favorite-longshot bias leaves favorites slightly underbet. Harvests the favorite half of FLB, confound-gated against folklore.
detail.edge_source: FLB favorite tail is documented as slim-positive net-of-vig on Kalshi but the sign is unstable on Polymarket, so the genuine new mechanism is the belief-blind by-band benchmark that isolates whether the favorite tail is actually underbet HERE rather than assuming the folklore. The naive 'bet favorites' edge is mostly already priced; only the confound-gated residual is credible.
detail.forward_test: AVG(outcome_won - entry_price) for the band, scored against a BLIND-by-band benchmark (all in-band markets, no consensus) AND against the existing 'favorite' portfolio strategy. Promote only if it beats blind-by-band by more than modeled fees; track per category because FLB sign is venue/category-specific.
detail.confounds: The whole 'edge' is the favorite-longshot bias, a property of the PRICE band — if it exists it is fully captured by blind-by-band betting, so the consensus signal adds nothing and the benchmark is designed to reveal exactly that null. Secondary confound: high in-band base rates make any positive AVG(outcome_won - entry) look like skill when it is just selecting near-certain YES events.
detail.fix: Reframe explicitly as a measurement-only null-probe (quantify FLB by band/category), NOT an edge; or supply a concrete positive mechanism for why consensus beats blind-by-band in the favorite tail (e.g. consensus identifies a forecastable subset where the public underprices favorites) and pre-register a power analysis with a hard gate: beat blind-by-band by more than modeled fees, per-category, on adequate N, before any promotion.

detail.name: clv-capture-overlay
detail.mechanism: For every forward-tracked portfolio signal, capture the CLOB mid at alert time and the last-trade mid just before resolution; CLV = closing_mid - entry_mid (signed to the side taken). Strategies whose forward signals show persistently positive median CLV are skill-confirmed and promoted many resolutions earlier than outcome-only scoring; negative-CLV strategies are killed early. Doubles as a suppression gate against entering after the line already moved.
detail.edge_source: CLV is the best-documented leading proxy for betting skill and is computable here because both venues' tapes are public. It is not itself priced-away because it is a diagnostic/accelerator, not an alert trigger: it lets us detect and kill strategies far earlier than slow resolutions and suppresses entries where the consensus side has already negative expected CLV.
detail.forward_test: Per strategy: median forward CLV AND AVG(outcome_won - entry_price), both on N>=threshold resolved signals. Promote only if BOTH > 0. CLV alone is gameable so it gates; resolution edge confirms. Also separates front-running info (positive CLV pre-move) from chasing (negative CLV post-move).
detail.confounds: Outcome-collinearity: defining closing_mid as last-trade-before-resolution makes CLV a near-restatement of the resolution edge (closing price already encodes the known outcome), so the two are not independent confirmations and the "acceleration" is partly reading a noisy outcome rather than detecting skill earlier. Secondary: thin-market mid noise/stale books inflate CLV variance on illiquid tokens.
detail.fix: Redefine CLV against a FIXED reference rather than last-trade-before-resolution: e.g. price move over a fixed horizon post-entry (next N hours/day) or a canonical pre-resolution "close" (event/game start for sports). Treat CLV as a variance-reduced EARLY skill estimate and an entry-suppression gate — NOT as an independent second confirmation of the resolution edge. Add a liquidity filter (min book depth/volume) before logging mids, and keep AVG(outcome_won − entry_price) as the sole banking metric.

detail.name: whale-conviction
detail.mechanism: Orthogonal conviction signal from on-chain holder concentration. Fire when the Polymarket /holders endpoint shows the top-20 holders of an outcome are both highly concentrated (Herfindahl) and one-sided (most large capital on the same outcome) on a non-longshot price band, independent of leaderboard-rank copy consensus.
detail.edge_source: Holder concentration is on-chain conviction capital not captured by rank-weighted consensus and not watched by retail, so it is plausibly orthogonal to the copy signal. Confounds handled explicitly: 20-holder cap + proxy wallets undercount, concentration correlates with illiquidity (longshot trap, hence band restriction), and a whale can be the loser (hence resolution-edge proof required, not concentration alone).
detail.forward_test: AVG(outcome_won - entry_price) vs blind-by-band; cross-tabulate with leaderboard consensus to prove concentration adds edge BEYOND the existing copy signal (orthogonality), not just re-detecting it.
detail.confounds: One-sidedness of conviction capital is mechanically collinear with the market price (the favored side attracts the heavy holders), so the signal risks re-detecting the favorite-longshot/efficient line rather than adding orthogonal information; secondarily, high Herfindahl concentration is collinear with illiquidity and price staleness, contaminating both the signal and the scored entry_price. Also likely non-orthogonal to the existing copy-consensus engine because leaderboard whales ARE often the concentrated holders.
detail.fix: Add an explicit liquidity/volume floor (e.g. gamma liquidity and 24h volume minimums) to separate conviction-concentration from illiquidity-concentration; weight Herfindahl by USDC (shares×price), not raw shares; residualize one_sidedness on price within band so it can't just fire the favorite; and make promotion conditional on the orthogonality gate actually passing — edge must beat BOTH band-blind AND a copy-consensus-controlled stratum on resolved outcomes, not just band-blind.

detail.name: fresh-open-mispricing
detail.mechanism: Discovery-phase edge. Up-weight or gate consensus signals to YOUNG markets (createdAt age below threshold) where spreads are wide and the prior is naive before sharp money arrives, when a tracked trader takes a coherent side. Front-runs price formation rather than chasing an already-adjusted line. Distinct from the existing fresh2h knob, which gates on FILL recency, not MARKET age.
detail.edge_source: Tetlock and the documented liquidity lifecycle: thin discovery-phase markets are less efficient because sharp money and attention have not arrived. The mispricing exists precisely before liquidity, so it is not yet priced. Honest limit: wide spread can be a transaction-cost illusion, controlled by spread logging and alert-only scoring.
detail.forward_test: AVG(outcome_won - entry_price) by market-age and TTR bucket; edge must be monotone in youth and survive a blind-by-band control (young markets skew longshot). Log realized spread per signal to flag non-fillable 'edge' (alert-only fills must use real depth).
detail.confounds: Non-fillability spread illusion: wide discovery-phase spreads make the mid/last entry_price unattainable, so the edge can be entirely transaction cost you could never capture; compounded by favorite-longshot skew of unconverged young markets and small double-conditioned sample sizes.
detail.fix: Make the confound controls the scoring rule, not a footnote: (1) score edge against an achievable fill — walk the live CLOB /book for a realistic clip (e.g. $100-500) at signal time and use that VWAP as entry_price, never mid/last; (2) define the benchmark as surplus over the blind-young-by-band baseline (young-longshot edge subtracted), not raw AVG(outcome_won - entry); (3) lock a minimum-N gate per age×TTR bucket before any claim and require monotonicity to survive that gate; (4) verify createdAt and consensus are read only at signal time to avoid look-ahead. If post-fill surplus over the blind-young baseline stays positive past the N gate, promote to viable.

detail.name: theta-drift-ttr-gate
detail.mechanism: Time-to-resolution gating overlay. Forward-learn the TTR window where copy-consensus edge actually survives: too early = empty book/noise, too late = line is efficient and price pins near extremes (theta drift). Restrict/up-weight alerts to the empirically best TTR window instead of assuming.
detail.edge_source: Documented time-decay/efficiency lifecycle: near resolution prices mean-revert and pin while the line prices in public info; far out the book is empty. The new mechanism is forward-LEARNING where on the TTR axis copy-edge survives rather than assuming a horizon. Cheap overlay on already-stored signals, so low downside.
detail.forward_test: AVG(outcome_won - entry_price) by TTR bucket; adopt a gate only if an interior window beats the all-TTR baseline out-of-sample (forward, sequential split) AND survives a blind-by-band control, since TTR correlates with price level.
detail.confounds: TTR is mechanically confounded with price level and market type: near resolution prices pin toward 0/1 (so entry_price and outcome_won are both extreme and favorite-longshot bias dominates the AVG(outcome_won-entry_price) score), while far-out signals skew toward different liquidity/category mixes. Any "interior sweet-spot window" can therefore be a pure price-level/longshot artifact rather than a copy-edge survival window — exactly the known efficiency-lifecycle confound the proposal cites as its edge_source.
detail.fix: Pre-register a SMALL fixed set of TTR bands (e.g. 3) before looking at outcomes; require the candidate interior band to (1) beat the all-TTR baseline out-of-sample, (2) still beat baseline AFTER matching/controlling on entry-price level and market category (so it's not a longshot/price-level artifact), AND (3) clear a minimum per-bucket forward-N power floor with a multiple-testing correction for the number of bands tested. Only then promote the gate; otherwise keep it as a read-only diagnostic, never an alert filter.

detail.name: obi-entry-timing-overlay
detail.mechanism: Pure entry-timing overlay generating NO new signals. When another strategy fires, snapshot the CLOB book and compute multi-level order-book imbalance for the taken outcome; recommend enter-now vs wait and measure whether OBI-aligned entries realize better CLV over the next minutes. Microstructure-grade timing, explicitly not hold-to-resolution alpha.
detail.edge_source: OBI has a documented near-linear short-horizon predictive link to mid moves, a sub-minute horizon that slow copy-consensus does not price. Honest limit kept from being illusory: thin PM books mean one cancel flips OBI, so it is scored ONLY as a CLV delta on already-fired signals (a timing overlay), never as standalone alpha.
detail.forward_test: CLV improvement: median (closing_mid - entry_mid) for OBI-aligned vs OBI-misaligned entries on the SAME underlying signals; plus directional hit-rate of sign(mid move over next N minutes) vs 50%.
detail.confounds: Thin-book OBI is near-pure noise / trivially spoofable (one cancel flips sign), so the "documented near-linear predictivity" from deep markets likely does not transfer; separately, the partition-by-alignment scoring confounds timing value with underlying signal quality.
detail.fix: Replace the partition test with a within-signal counterfactual: for each fired signal compute OBI, then test whether sign(OBI) predicts the direction/magnitude of the achievable mid improvement over [T, T+N] (and a plain diagnostic: hit-rate of sign(OBI)=sign(next-N-min mid move) vs 50%). Pre-register a minimum multi-level book-depth/liquidity filter so OBI isn't scored on noise-dominated books, and ship it first as a pure diagnostic — only promote to a 'wait' recommendation if the depth-filtered hit-rate clears 50% out-of-sample.

detail.name: xvenue-pair-registry-and-dual-feed
detail.mechanism: Foundation layer every other cross-venue strategy depends on: a human-confirmed registry mapping Polymarket conditionId <-> Kalshi ticker, plus a synchronized dual price/book feed. There is no shared market ID; production arb bots use curated whitelists because fuzzy title/date matching misfires. Auto-propose candidate pairs (normalize slug/title + event date + outcome side), require one-click human confirm, then stream both books. This is not itself an edge but it is the gate that makes every divergence signal trustworthy and kills the dominant false-edge (resolution mismatch).
detail.edge_source: Not an edge; it removes the #1 source of fake edges (look-identical/resolve-different pairs) and provides depth-confirmed quotes so later signals are not chasing stale single-MM quotes.
detail.forward_test: Mapping precision/recall vs a reference oracle (Prediction Hunt /v2/matching-markets, used only to validate not as data source); and a resolution-audit metric = fraction of 'identical' pairs that actually resolved to the same outcome. Target >0.98 resolution-concordance before any pair is eligible for arb scoring.
detail.confounds: The strongest counter is that the whole foundation may be infrastructure for a non-existent edge: the same events on two liquid venues are largely arbitraged already, observed 'divergence' is often a stale single-MM quote or fee/spread-sized noise, and the only realizable capture (two-legged trade) is barred by the alert/paper-only constraint — so the registry could be perfectly correct yet feed signals with no harvestable surplus.
detail.fix: Gate the build: ship only the thin slice first — auto-pair sports (Kalshi KXWCGAME/KXWCTOTAL team+date vs PM fifwc-* slugs) plus the resolution-concordance audit on a handful of pairs — and require a cheap manual spot-check showing divergence magnitude exceeds fees+spread on the paper-trackable basis BEFORE committing to the full synchronized depth feed. Treat Prediction Hunt as validation-only (never a data dependency).

detail.name: pm-leads-kalshi-leadlag-follower
detail.mechanism: Documented (SSRN 5331995, 2024-election common contracts): Polymarket leads Kalshi in price discovery, driven by directional order flow from large trades; net order imbalance predicts subsequent returns. When Polymarket's mid moves >=X cents on a confirmed pair and Kalshi has NOT followed within T minutes, Kalshi's stale price is a predictable short-horizon target. Alert 'Kalshi likely to move toward Polymarket', paper-entry on the lagging Kalshi side.
detail.edge_source: Real capital-transfer friction (Kalshi ACH 1-3 day settlement vs instant Polymarket USDC) means the two venues do NOT instantly arb to parity; the slower, US-politics-anchored Kalshi crowd genuinely lags Polymarket's crypto-native flow, so the move is forecastable rather than already priced.
detail.forward_test: Two-horizon score: (a) convergence hit-rate = does Kalshi mid move in the PM direction within H minutes (sign match); (b) resolution edge = AVG(outcome_won − kalshi_entry_price) on the followed side. Must beat blind-by-price-band (favorite-longshot control) and a same-pair shuffle null. Bucket by liquidity and category.
detail.confounds: Buying after PM's move at Kalshi's marketable (spread-crossed) price means you pay up to an already-efficient price; the convergence metric will look like edge (this is a momentum/already-priced confound) even when net-of-spread resolution edge is zero. The settlement-friction 'why it isn't arbed' story is undercut by arb bots that pre-fund both venues.
detail.fix: Trigger and score on the EXECUTABLE Kalshi price (ask for longs, bid for shorts) plus fees — never mid; store the inside quote (not just mid) in the replay atoms; gate on net-of-crossing-cost surplus; and require the RESOLUTION-edge test (not convergence hit-rate) to clear the bar on a confirmed-registry mirrored-pair set, bucketed by liquidity.

detail.name: depth-confirmed-dutch-divergence-alert
detail.mechanism: When combined cost of YES on one venue + NO on the other (the dutch/arbitrage book) is < $1.00 net of modeled fees on a depth-confirmed, resolution-matched pair, that is a structural mispricing. We place no trades, so it collapses to an alert + paper position; forward-scored by whether the gap actually closes by resolution (locking the modeled profit).
detail.edge_source: True cross-venue arb windows are seconds-to-minutes on headline markets, but niche/low-liquidity pairs sustain 5-10c gaps for hours-days because moving capital between venues is slow and frictional (ACH delay, KYC, geo limits). The persistence IS the edge and it is not arbitraged away precisely because of those real frictions.
detail.forward_test: Per signal log modeled dutch profit at alert; at resolution compute realized payoff of the paper YES/NO pair. Edge = AVG(realized dutch P&L) and gap half-life (hours to close). Confound gates: exclude pairs failing resolution audit; require depth so the 'edge' isn't single-MM transaction cost.
detail.confounds: Resolution concordance is make-or-break and the classic source of fake cross-venue arbs: 'same event' markets can differ on draw/extra-time/penalties handling, settlement source, timing, and tie/void rules, so a displayed sub-$1.00 book can lose BOTH legs. Persistent 5-10c gaps are suspicious precisely because a free liquid arb would be taken — most are either resolution mismatches or have no real depth behind the top quote.
