Two leakage traps: (a) post-hoc exclusion of 'failed resolution audit' pairs after seeing outcomes is selection leakage — the concordance gate must be set at alert time and pre-registered; (b) gap-closure/half-life is the wrong primary metric (a real arb is held to resolution and doesn't care if the gap closes) — only realized hold-to-resolution payoff scores the edge.
detail.fix: Pre-register the resolution-concordance gate (settlement source, tie/draw/ET/void rules, settlement-date match) BEFORE resolution and never exclude pairs post-hoc on outcome; treat hold-to-resolution realized dutch P&L as the sole edge metric (gap half-life is diagnostic only); require true book depth (sum of levels to size S, not just top-of-book) net of conservative fees; and expect the honest forward test to refute the bulk of 'persistent niche' signals while certifying only a concordance-clean, depth-real tail.

detail.name: category-divergence-halflife-tracker
detail.mechanism: Run the divergence monitor split by category (crypto / sports / elections / econ) and learn which categories sustain the widest, slowest-closing gaps. Hypothesis from the briefs: Polymarket richer/sharper on crypto + international/geopolitical (crypto-native base), Kalshi sharper on US-politics/econ — so the lagging venue is category-dependent. Output is a learned routing table that tells the lead-lag and dutch strategies WHERE their edge is concentrated.
detail.edge_source: Structural, not yet priced because it's a cross-sectional meta-pattern: each venue's user base systematically misprices the OTHER's home turf, and no single-market arb closes a category-wide tilt. It's a param/bucketing layer once the base feed exists, so cheap to run.
detail.forward_test: Per category track: mean divergence magnitude, gap half-life, lead-venue win-rate, and downstream resolution edge of signals fired in that category. Validates the hypothesis that niche+crypto sustain larger/slower gaps; promotes only categories whose forward edge survives the favorite-longshot control.
detail.confounds: Cross-venue basis: the largest, slowest-closing gaps are disproportionately markets that are NOT truly fungible (different resolution criteria/cutoff/fees), so "edge concentration" by divergence size selects for non-convergent contract differences rather than mispricing — and post-hoc picking the widest-gap category inflates false positives.
detail.fix: Promote categories on realized downstream RESOLUTION edge only (never on raw divergence size or half-life), after (a) a fungibility pre-screen that confirms identical resolution source/cutoff so basis is stripped from mispricing, (b) a per-bucket minimum-N floor with explicit multiple-comparison correction across categories, and (c) the favorite-longshot control already named. Treat it as a low-cost reporting overlay on the proven base feed, not a signal generator.

detail.name: xvenue-orderflow-imbalance-lead
detail.mechanism: Operationalizes the SSRN mechanism directly: the venue with greater directional order flow from large/aggressive trades leads; net taker-signed imbalance predicts the OTHER venue's subsequent repricing. Compute net large-trade taker imbalance per venue from Polymarket CLOB fills + Kalshi public trade tape; alert when one venue's imbalance burst has not yet been absorbed by the other venue's price.
detail.edge_source: Order-flow imbalance has a documented short-horizon predictive link to price; the lagging venue hasn't absorbed the informed flow because cross-venue arbitrageurs face capital friction. Not priced on the lagging venue precisely in the seconds-to-minutes before its book catches up. Deeper build (signed-flow estimation from taker side + WS plumbing).
detail.forward_test: Short-horizon: does venue-B mid move in the predicted direction within H minutes (hit-rate vs 50%). Resolution-horizon: AVG(outcome_won − entry) on the predicted side. Critical confound split: separate front-running genuine info (both venues SHOULD move on news) from chasing — control by checking whether A's move was itself preceded by a price jump (news) vs pure flow. Beat blind-by-price-band.
detail.confounds: The dominant confound is genuine-information co-movement: real news moves BOTH venues, so a raw lead-lag hit-rate above 50% is expected even with zero exploitable edge. The proposal's news-control (did A's move follow a price jump?) is necessary but imperfect, and after removing news-driven cases the remaining pure-flow sample may be too small/fast to capture. Secondary: cross-venue contract-mapping errors (Kalshi YES vs Polymarket outcomeIndex, tick/fee/clock-skew) manufacture phantom divergences, and Polymarket taker-side must be inferred rather than read.
detail.fix: Restrict to medium-liquidity markets only; require a minimum exploitable horizon H large enough that alert latency is negligible and score paper entry strictly at the next post-signal B mid; make the news-vs-flow split a hard gate (report edge ONLY on the pure-flow, no-prior-price-jump subset) and beat blind-by-price-band within that subset; validate contract mapping with a divergence-sanity check before counting any signal.

detail.name: xvenue-agreement-confound-gate
detail.mechanism: Defensive overlay that uses cross-venue agreement as a confound check on the EXISTING Polymarket copy-consensus engine. When Polymarket consensus traders take a coherent side AND Kalshi's independent price already agrees with that side, the information is likely already priced (two independent venues concur) — so the consensus 'edge' is weaker. When Kalshi DISagrees / lags, the consensus signal is more likely genuinely new. Downweight/suppress alerts where Kalshi already agrees; tag the rest as higher-conviction.
detail.edge_source: Separates genuinely new private signal from already-priced public info — the core 'line already prices it' confound. Two independent venues agreeing is strong evidence the edge is priced; one lagging is evidence it isn't. This refines an existing money-maker rather than inventing one, so it's near-param-only once the Kalshi feed exists.
detail.forward_test: A/B the existing 'strict' (and other) strategies with vs without the gate: compare AVG(outcome_won − entry) on gated-high-conviction subset vs the agree-already subset vs ungated baseline. Credible only if the lag/disagree subset's forward edge exceeds the agree subset by a margin surviving the favorite-longshot and sample-size controls.
detail.confounds: Strongest confound: disagreement is symmetric and adverse-selection-prone — the disagree bucket may underperform because PM consensus is wrong, not because it leads; compounded by structural basis (differing resolution terms between matched Kalshi/PM markets) masquerading as the 'mispricing' magnitude.
detail.fix: Demote from active alert gate to a passive logged diagnostic: store cross-venue gap + sign as an atom on every matched signal, then (a) empirically measure each bucket's forward edge before gating, (b) establish lead-lag direction per category first, and (c) flag large gaps as basis-suspect (resolution-term audit) rather than alpha. Only promote to a gate if the disagree bucket's forward edge beats the agree bucket by a margin surviving favorite-longshot and sample-size controls.

detail.name: kalshi-taker-flow-momentum
detail.mechanism: Aggressive takers cross the spread because they are impatient/informed; net taker-signed volume imbalance has documented short-horizon predictive power on subsequent price. In thin Kalshi books resting maker quotes update with lag, so a burst of one-sided aggression precedes the maker re-pricing. This is the closest Kalshi-native substitute for the missing copy-consensus signal.
detail.edge_source: Not priced because the venue lacks public position/leaderboard data, so most participants cannot see aggregate aggression; the maker layer in low-liquidity Kalshi markets re-quotes with measurable lag. Must be shown to survive favorite-longshot (beat blind-by-band) and to front-run repricing rather than chase news already in the tape.
detail.forward_test: Primary: edge = AVG(outcome_won - entry_price) on the alerted side at resolution, bucketed by entry price band, vs blind-by-price-band baseline. Secondary timing metric: directional hit-rate of mid-price move over next 15/60m (>50%) and CLV (entry mid -> last-trade-before-close).
detail.confounds: Chasing priced-in news: in thin prediction markets one-sided taker bursts are overwhelmingly news-driven (goal, poll, print), so by alert time the move is justified and priced — you enter into the chase, not ahead of repricing. Compounded by favorite-longshot and the spread cost of taking.
detail.fix: Demote resolution-edge; make short-horizon continuation/CLV the PRIMARY metric. Add a lagged-entry control (enter 5m after signal) — edge surviving = capturing repricing, edge vanishing = chasing. Add a news-coincidence filter using the mirrored cross-venue feed to exclude bursts simultaneous with score/poll/price events. Apply a real spread haircut, restrict to low-liquidity markets, and require beating BOTH blind-by-band and the lagged-entry control.

detail.name: kalshi-book-imbalance-obi
detail.mechanism: Multi-level order-book imbalance is a near-linear short-horizon predictor of mid moves (microstructure literature). On Kalshi the YES bid book and the inverted NO bid book give both sides; depth-weighted imbalance signals which way the book will walk before it does.
detail.edge_source: Short-horizon, execution-grade signal that the line has not yet absorbed; edge is the lag between book pressure and mid update. Honestly fragile in thin books (one cancel flips it) — depth floor + multi-level weighting are the confound guards; expected role is entry-timing/CLV overlay rather than a resolution edge.
detail.forward_test: Timing-grade: directional hit-rate of mid move over next 1/5/15m vs 50%, and CLV improvement when used to time entry on a signal another strategy already fired. Resolution-grade overlay: AVG(outcome_won - entry_price) by price band vs blind. Report both so it is judged as a timing overlay, not standalone alpha.
detail.confounds: Strongest confound: measured OBI predictivity will be (a) MM inventory/quoting artifacts in thin books, not informed flow, and (b) a mid-vs-executable-price illusion — Kalshi event spreads (several cents) exceed any plausible OBI-timing gain, so scoring against mid manufactures a phantom edge that vanishes against tradeable bid/ask.
detail.fix: Demote from "overlay we use" to a null-calibrated research probe: forward-track silently (store top-K book atom), and FIRST empirically establish whether OBI has ANY forward predictivity on Kalshi books at 1/5/15m vs a shuffle null, scored strictly against EXECUTABLE bid/ask (never mid) net of spread. Only promote if it beats the spread-aware null on adequate N; never alert on it given the benefit is unharvestable without order placement.

detail.name: kalshi-large-print-follow
detail.mechanism: A single aggressive print far above the rolling median size proxies informed conviction. Because Kalshi hides individual positions, the large taker print is the only public who-is-confident signal; following the aggressor side captures informed flow before makers fully reprice.
detail.edge_source: Substitutes for the unavailable Kalshi leaderboard/position copy-signal using only the public tape. Not priced if large aggressors carry private info the maker layer is slow to reflect. Confounds: a whale can be the loser, and size correlates with illiquidity (favorite-longshot trap) — guarded by price-band baseline and taker-vs-maker separation.
detail.forward_test: Edge = AVG(outcome_won - entry_price) on the print side at resolution, bucketed by price band and by print-size decile, vs blind-by-band. Also short-horizon continuation hit-rate (does mid move in print direction over next 30/60m). A large print that is a maker absorption (opposite) is logged separately as a control.
detail.confounds: Order-flow informativeness is real, but the attainable version is eaten by spread + Kalshi taker fees and by makers repricing faster than a human alert can act; scoring at the whale's own (unattainable) fill price is a look-ahead-flavored bias, and print size correlates with illiquid longshot markets (favorite-longshot) only partly absorbed by the band baseline.
detail.fix: Score at the ATTAINABLE post-print fill (next available ask/mid after a realistic reaction latency), subtract Kalshi taker fees + half-spread, and require the band-relative continuation edge (not the print's own entry) to survive forward vs blind-by-band before any signal is trusted.

detail.name: kalshi-liquidity-vacuum-reversion
detail.mechanism: Thin/low-attention books are less efficient (Tetlock): a small notional can move price far, producing transient mispricings that revert once liquidity arrives. Flagging a thinness-driven price spike and tracking reversion harvests the discovery-phase inefficiency.
detail.edge_source: Mispricing exists precisely because the book is thin and unwatched — but that same thinness means it is hard to fill, so the honest claim is alert/measurement, not capacity. Edge survives only if reversion beats blind AND modeled fill depth is respected; main confound is that a thin-book move can be real news, controlled by age/OI bucketing.
detail.forward_test: Resolution edge = AVG(outcome_won - entry_price) on the fade side vs blind-by-band, bucketed by market-age and OI buckets. Secondary: realized mid reversion fraction over next 1-6h (did it retrace the spike?). Paper fills must use modeled realistic depth or the edge is illusory.
detail.confounds: Bid-ask bounce on thin books makes mid-reversion appear automatically (mechanical, uncapturable), and the spread you must cross to actually fade likely exceeds the reversion — so a real-looking mid-reversion signal yields zero or negative executable edge, while genuine news moves (permanent) get faded into losses.
detail.fix: Score on the TRADE TAPE (actual executions), not mid, to kill the bounce artifact; define edge as executable reversion NET of the spread you'd cross (entry = realistic fade fill against modeled depth), not mid-retrace fraction. Add an event-window filter (strip in-game/news windows for sports/econ-print markets) so age/OI isn't the only news control. Pre-register: only 'viable' if net-of-spread fade beats blind-by-price-band on >=N resolved signals AND reversion fraction holds after excluding bounce-only (no-print) moves.

detail.name: kalshi-price-flow-divergence
detail.mechanism: Reverse-line-movement analog: when mid price drifts one way (maker quoting) but net aggressive taker flow points the OTHER way, the taker (sharp) side is the informed pressure and the drift is noise. Betting the flow side against the price drift is the canonical sharp-vs-public tell, reconstructed from public tape + book.
detail.edge_source: Most explicitly 'not already priced' candidate: it isolates informed aggression from line drift, so it should beat both blind-by-band and a naive momentum control. Without public positions this is the only way to reconstruct sharp-vs-public on Kalshi. Confounds: a single large stale-quote lift can fake divergence (depth-floor guard) and look-ahead alignment must be strict (flow measured only up to signal time).
detail.forward_test: Edge = AVG(outcome_won - entry_price) on the flow side at resolution vs blind-by-band, bucketed by price band. Secondary: does mid subsequently revert toward the flow side over next 30-120m (sign-of-reversal hit-rate)? Compare against a same-side (price-following) control to confirm the divergence, not momentum, is what pays.
detail.confounds: The strongest counter: in thin prediction-market books, "divergence" is dominated by stale/one-lot quote artifacts and maker inventory management, not informed aggression. Without identity you cannot distinguish sharp taker pressure from retail momentum-chasing that makers rationally fade, so the signal is most plausibly the inverse of the claimed edge — and on illiquid Kalshi markets the depth-floor guard will either starve sample size or admit phantoms.
detail.fix: Forward-track SILENTLY only (never alert): require it to beat BOTH blind-by-band AND the same-side momentum control on large N before any belief; restrict to flagship liquid markets (World Cup, marquee) with a hard depth/notional floor to kill stale-quote phantoms; and explicitly also forward-track the OPPOSITE (price-following) variant in the same harness, since the maker-fades-flow reading predicts that one wins — let the tape arbitrate which direction actually pays before committing to the divergence sign.

detail.name: kalshi-spread-compression-breakout
detail.mechanism: Sharp tightening of the bid-ask spread signals information arrival / liquidity provision regime change that typically precedes a directional move as quotes converge to a new fair value. Combining a spread-compression trigger with the concurrent OBI tilt gives a direction.
detail.edge_source: Spread regime change is a leading indicator that the line is about to move (information not yet in mid), so acting at compression front-runs the repricing. Not priced because few watch spread dynamics on niche Kalshi markets. Confounds: compression can be benign liquidity arrival with no drift — the OBI-matched random-time control is the decisive guard.
detail.forward_test: Directional hit-rate of mid move over next 15/60m vs 50%, plus resolution edge = AVG(outcome_won - entry_price) by price band vs blind. Control: random-time OBI-matched samples (without compression) to prove the compression trigger adds signal beyond OBI alone.
detail.confounds: The OBI-matched control will most likely show compression adds ~nothing over OBI alone, collapsing the strategy to a generic order-book-imbalance momentum bet — a studied, exploited, fragile effect. Additionally, reverse causality (the move causes the compression) and mid-to-mid scoring that ignores spread-crossing + Kalshi fees both inflate apparent edge.
detail.fix: (1) Make the OBI-matched control the PRIMARY kill switch, not a footnote — promote only if compression-conditioned hit-rate beats OBI-matched samples by a pre-registered margin. (2) Require the OBI tilt to PREDATE the compression to break reverse causality. (3) Score realized fillable PnL (cross-the-spread + Kalshi fees), not mid-to-mid. (4) Restrict to markets above a liquidity/trade-count floor so "mid" is meaningful.

detail.name: scraper-fidelity-canary
detail.mechanism: A first-class data-reliability gate that ALL the scraped strategies must pass before any of their edges are believed. Continuously reconcile scraped position CHANGES against ground-truth that IS in free official data: when a scraped profile shows a new/changed position, verify a corresponding execution appears on Kalshi's public trade tape (price/side/size/timestamp window). Produces a per-snapshot fidelity score; degrades or quarantines strategies when the scraper drifts, stalls, or the frontend/GraphQL breaks.
detail.edge_source: Not an alpha source — it's the honesty/risk gate that makes the scraped family trustworthy. Scraped data is brittle, paid, ToS-gray, and only covers opted-in profiles; without cross-checking it against the free public trade tape, every scraped 'edge' is unfalsifiable and could be a stale-frontend artifact. This converts data-reliability from an unmodeled risk into a measured, enforced gate.
detail.forward_test: Two metrics: (1) reconciliation match-rate over time (does scraped data correspond to real tape?); (2) does conditioning every scraped strategy on fidelity=GREEN windows improve their forward edge vs ungated? Win condition: gated edges are non-regressive and RED windows correctly precede the snapshots where naive scraped signals would have mis-fired.
detail.confounds: Attribution ambiguity: the public Kalshi trade tape carries no wallet identity, so per-delta 'does a matching print exist' cannot distinguish a genuinely fresh scraped position from a coincidental same-size/price print by an unrelated trader, nor flag a real position whose fill was split/aggregated. In any liquid ticker the match-rate is therefore confounded by background trade density, not scraper fidelity.
detail.fix: Ship the deterministic, identity-free half only: snapshot freshness/latency, named-profile coverage delta vs prior run, schema/anonymization break detection, and the one-directional sanity rule (a position delta with ZERO tape activity in that market+window = RED). Drop or heavily down-weight the precise per-delta match-rate to a coarse 'plausibility' flag. Gate deployment on at least one scraped-family strategy first demonstrating standalone, leak-free forward edge — otherwise the non-regression win condition is vacuous.

detail.name: auto-promotion-gate
detail.mechanism: Converts the per-strategy forward scoreboard into an automatic, belief-blind promotion decision. Today `alerting` is hardcoded to `strict` (consensus.rs StrategyDef); this flips alerting ON when a silently-forward-tracked strategy proves durable edge and OFF when it decays. Value = the bot alerts only on strategies whose realized surplus is statistically real, suppressing strategies that merely got lucky on small N.
detail.edge_source: Process/meta edge, not a market edge: naive 'rank strategies by raw AVG(outcome_won-price)' promotes favorite-longshot base-rate artifacts and lucky small-N strategies. The confound floor + event-clustering + lower-bound make promotion survive exactly the confounds the brief warns about. Not priced because it disciplines our own alerting, not the market.
detail.forward_test: Log every promote/demote decision with timestamp; score gate PRECISION by the strictly out-of-window edge of promoted strategies vs never-promoted/demoted ones. A good gate yields positive forward surplus on the promoted set and ~0 on the rest. Metric = post-decision AVG(outcome_won - mean_price) split by gate verdict.
detail.confounds: The gate cures per-signal confounds but introduces a fresh one it never addresses: sequential optional-stopping (promote on first lower-bound crossing) plus 10-strategy multiplicity. A nominal 95% per-strategy bound is neither sequentially valid nor family-wise corrected, so "statistically real surplus" is overstated — the lucky-small-N artifact re-enters as a lucky-which-strategy-and-which-peek artifact.
detail.fix: Replace the fixed 95% bootstrap lower-bound with an always-valid confidence sequence (alpha-spending / e-process) so repeated peeking is licensed, add a family-wise/FDR correction across the 10 strategies, and gate on a minimum-EVENTS floor (cluster N_eff, e.g. ≥25 distinct event_slugs) rather than 40 raw signals. Pre-register N_min and evaluate only at fixed checkpoints. With those, promotions become genuinely durable rather than first-crossing noise.

detail.name: blind-band-benchmark
detail.mechanism: For every resolved signal, computes the counterfactual edge of a BLIND bettor in the same (price-band x category x venue) bucket, then reports each strategy's edge as SURPLUS over blind. This is the confound instrument the gate consumes; it stops the bot mistaking favorite-longshot base-rate for skill. Currently edge is reported raw vs entry (storage/consensus.rs), which a heavy-favorite strategy can game.
detail.edge_source: Removes the favorite-longshot and bucket base-rate confounds that make raw edge look positive. Honest accounting infra, not a market edge; it is the denominator the whole portfolio is judged against.
detail.forward_test: Track AVG(surplus) and its lower CI per strategy as markets resolve. Self-validate the benchmark by confirming a deliberately random/blind shadow strategy scores surplus ~= 0; a real strategy must score surplus CI > 0.
detail.confounds: The benchmark can launder a confound rather than remove it: if the blind pool is the signaled set, surplus understates edge for strategies that dominate a bucket (the baseline becomes the strategy itself) and inherits portfolio-wide selection bias; and price-band x category x venue shatters into thin cells, so a noisy blind estimate plus event-clustered CIs can make a real surplus look indeterminate (or a spurious one look significant).
detail.fix: Define the blind baseline from the unconditional resolved-market universe per (price-band x category x venue), not from signaled signals; estimate it expanding-window/leave-one-out to prevent baseline look-ahead; coarsen bands and use Wilson/event-clustered CIs for thin cells; and keep the blind-shadow self-validation (must score surplus≈0) as a permanent null check.

detail.name: atom-replay-cli
detail.mechanism: Realizes the 'no-backtest superpower' that 022 only set up storage for. A CLI re-scores any NEW StrategyDef param-set over already-collected observed_votes atoms and joins resolution to produce the SAME forward scoreboard instantly, so a strategy can be tuned and vetted offline before it is committed to live forward tracking. Also widens atom capture to ALL observed market-books, not just fired signals, so replay is unbiased for looser strategies.
detail.edge_source: Pure leverage + honesty infra: turns weeks of forward waiting into instant re-scoring with no look-ahead (atoms are point-in-time snapshots). The capture widening fixes a survivorship confound where replay otherwise only sees markets some existing strategy already liked.
detail.forward_test: Calibrate the tool itself: for each param-set first replayed then forward-run, compare replay-predicted surplus to realized forward surplus (must agree within CI). Capture-completeness measured as % of a new looser strategy's live signals whose atoms were already present before the widening.
detail.confounds: Multiple-testing / in-sample selection: an arbitrary number of param-sets scored over one shared, event-correlated atom history will produce false 'surplus>0' winners; combined with favorite-longshot bias baked into the raw surplus metric, replay will preferentially greenlight confounded strategies that then burn forward-tracking slots. Historical atoms are also survivorship-biased toward existing filters, so the looser strategies the tool most wants to explore are exactly the ones it cannot honestly replay until post-widening data accrues.
detail.fix: Keep the binding gate strictly forward-only (the proposal already does: forward-commit only after live tracking, replay is a prefilter — preserve that and never let replay surplus substitute for forward proof). Add: (1) multiple-testing control — register the param-set count and require a Bonferroni/FDR- or holdout-adjusted surplus lower-bound, not a naive per-search >0; (2) event/cycle-clustered (not per-signal) CIs to defeat within-event correlation; (3) a price-stratified / FLB-neutral surplus so replay doesn't just rank longshot/favorite loaders; (4) disjoint-window calibration (replay window A → predict forward window B) instead of self-overlapping resolution; (5) flag any replayed strategy looser than the historical filter union as 'survivorship-unsafe — accrue post-widening data before trusting.' With these guards it becomes legitimately viable honesty infra.

detail.name: cluster-robust-dedup
detail.mechanism: Collapses correlated signals so BOTH the alert stream and the scoreboard treat one event as one observation. Multiple portfolio strategies firing on the same (condition,outcome), and many outcomes within one World Cup match/event, are not independent; counting them as independent inflates alert noise AND the gate's significance.
detail.edge_source: Directly fixes the within-match non-independence leak (Tue's documented leak class) that would otherwise let the gate promote noise, and cuts alert fatigue. Internal correctness, not market-priced.
detail.forward_test: Measure alert-volume reduction at equal market coverage; and on resolved data, compare the gate's false-promotion rate using raw-N vs cluster-N (cluster-N should reduce spurious promotions). Metric = #spurious promotions averted + alert count delta.
detail.confounds: It generates no edge — it only protects against false belief in edge and cuts alert fatigue, so its payoff is internal and asserted more than short-term-provable. Worse, with few independent events the cluster-robust CIs can be unstable/anti-conservative, and over-shrinking effective-N could starve promotion entirely (never promote) — the correction could trade false promotions for false rejections.
detail.fix: Pre-register the cluster key (cluster = event_slug, strategy firings nested within (condition,outcome)) and use a small-cluster correction (wild-cluster bootstrap or t with G-1 dof) rather than plain robust SEs so few-event slates don't blow up. Make 'spurious promotions averted' measurable instead of asserted by holding out a fixed forward window and comparing whether cluster-gated vs raw-gated promotions survive out-of-sample resolutions; keep the dedup/digest change behind a config flag so the conservative effective-N can't silently zero out the alert stream.

detail.name: wallet-skill-universe
detail.mechanism: Selects and weights the tracked-trader universe by forward-measured directional CONTRIBUTION edge instead of raw leaderboard PnL/volume (which inflates market-makers and pure size). Wallets whose backed signals consistently lose are demoted or excluded, sharpening the input to every consensus strategy. The current universe is union-of-top-N-by-rank (leaderboard_tracker.rs) with no quality screen.
detail.edge_source: Leaderboard PnL rewards size and two-sided market-making, not directional skill on the fresh, price-coherent bets consensus keys on; forward contribution-edge measures the thing we actually copy. Guarded against regression-to-mean by min-K + shrinkage. Not priced because the leaderboard rank itself is the public proxy everyone uses.
detail.forward_test: Run the skill-filtered universe as a shadow strategy alongside the raw top-N universe and compare consensus surplus-over-blind on subsequently-resolved signals; the skill universe must beat raw with clustered CI.
detail.confounds: Favorite-longshot bias contaminates the contribution_edge metric: backers of favorites earn systematically positive (outcome_won - price) with zero skill, so the 'skill universe' may just be a 'backs-favorites universe' — itself the most-priced public bias. Plus skill persistence (past contribution edge -> future) is assumed, not demonstrated; could be selecting lucky wallets.
detail.fix: Redefine contribution_edge as surplus OVER a per-price blind baseline (residualize each backed signal against the FLB-adjusted expected win-rate at that price), not raw outcome_won - mean_price, so favoriteness is netted out and only directional skill remains. Compute it strictly walk-forward with point-in-time-frozen wallet weights, keep min-K + shrink-to-zero, and run purely as a shadow universe with clustered (per-event) CI for many weeks before any promotion; promote only if it beats the raw top-N universe on surplus-over-blind with a CI clear of zero.

detail.name: cross-venue-resolution-truth
detail.mechanism: Builds the shared multi-venue data layer that every cross-venue strategy needs: ingest Kalshi public market data, maintain a curated polymarket<->kalshi pair table, and add a dual-venue resolution reconciler. Beyond unlocking divergence/lead-lag families, it is itself a confound FILTER: it flags and suppresses signals on markets whose two venues settle differently (resolution mismatch is the dominant cross-venue false-edge) and on dispute-prone UMA markets.
detail.edge_source: Free market data on both sides; the edge is avoided losses, since naive cross-venue arb/divergence bets die to resolution mismatch, the #1 documented cross-venue false edge. Personal, alert-only, non-redistributed, no model-training keeps it inside Kalshi's Data ToS.
detail.forward_test: Count resolution mismatches caught per N curated pairs; measure edge degradation of any strategy on mismatch-flagged vs clean markets (should be large), which validates the suppression filter. Pairing precision validated against a paid unified API used READ-ONLY as a reference oracle.
detail.confounds: Two real weaknesses. (1) It generates zero standalone signal — its payoff is entirely contingent on the divergence/lead-lag families it feeds, which are unproven; worse, the mechanism cuts the other way: if resolution mismatch is the DOMINANT source of apparent cross-venue divergence, then after the filter the residual divergence on truly-identical markets may be ~0 (efficient near-arb), i.e. the filter could reveal the whole family is dead rather than unlock it. (2) The forward_test proposes validating pairing precision against a PAID unified API "read-only as reference oracle," which violates the FREE-data hard constraint — and the manual title+date+outcome pairing is fragile/low-throughput since no shared market ID exists.
detail.fix: Drop the paid reference-oracle entirely; validate pairing precision by human spot-check of the auto-proposed whitelist (small N, one-time) to stay strictly inside the free-data constraint. Add an explicit kill-criterion: if, after mismatch-flagged pairs are removed, the clean-pair divergence/lead-lag families show no measurable forward edge over M resolutions, retire the family rather than keep maintaining the layer — so the infra is held accountable to a downstream result, not built open-endedly.

detail.name: kelly-paper-pnl
detail.mechanism: Replace the flat per-signal edge metric AVG(outcome_won - entry) with an honest economic objective: size each paper position by fractional Kelly f* = edge/(1-entry) capped at 1/4-Kelly, derived from the consensus-implied win prob vs the entry mean_price, and accumulate log-bankroll per strategy. A strategy only 'earns' if it compounds capital, not if it wins thin marginal bets.
detail.edge_source: Flat AVG(outcome_won-entry) equal-weights a 0.05 longshot and a 0.90 favorite, so a strategy can show 'edge' from a few lucky high-variance longshots. Kelly log-growth is the actual money objective and exposes that variance as the risk it is; this is honest accounting, not a market mispricing claim.
detail.forward_test: Terminal paper bankroll and cumulative log-growth per strategy over resolved signals, vs flat-stake edge AND vs blind-by-price-band Kelly. Strategy ranks by realized log-growth, not raw hit-rate.
detail.confounds: Self-fulfilling sizing: using realized (full-sample) per-strategy edge as p_hat means strategies that overperformed in-sample are automatically allocated more capital, manufacturing apparent log-growth. Compounded by correlated simultaneous signals breaking the independence Kelly assumes.
detail.fix: Make p_hat strictly causal (expanding-window estimate using only signals resolved before each signal's timestamp, never its own/future outcome); add a per-resolution-window correlated-exposure cap so simultaneous stakes can't exceed bankroll; report Kelly log-growth as a complementary economic metric ALONGSIDE flat edge and blind-by-price-band Kelly, not a silent replacement.

detail.name: belief-blind-promotion-gate
detail.mechanism: Strategy-of-strategies promotion controller: a forward-tracked variant is only allowed to graduate from silent to alerting when its edge clears a power-and-Bayes floor. Beta-Binomial posterior on hit-rate vs the price-band-matched blind baseline must put P(true edge > confound floor) > 0.95 AND resolved-N must exceed a power threshold for the observed effect size.
detail.edge_source: Does not create edge; it prevents the system from acting on noise. The meta-edge is avoiding false positives on n=10 samples and the favorite-longshot confound by gating on a band-matched blind baseline. This is exactly the belief-blind rigor gate the methodology demands.
detail.forward_test: Track each strategy's promotion/demotion timeline; the meta-metric is out-of-sample edge AFTER promotion (does a promoted variant sustain edge on signals resolved post-promotion) and the false-promotion rate (promoted variants that later revert).
detail.confounds: Look-elsewhere / winner's-curse: a per-strategy P>0.95 applied across 10 forward-tracked variants (plus arbitrarily many invented-later replays over the same stored atom set) inflates the family-wise false-promotion rate far above the nominal 5%. The controller built to suppress noise-promotion is itself uncorrected for the multiplicity it sits on top of, which is the central irony.
detail.fix: Make it a two-sample Bayesian test on the difference (posterior over p_strategy - p_blind with baseline uncertainty propagated), apply a family-wise/FDR correction (Benjamini-Hochberg or a hierarchical shrinkage prior pooling the strategy family) across all live and replayed variants, and score on the actual continuous PnL edge (outcome_won - entry_price) via a Normal/bootstrap posterior rather than a hit-rate Beta-Binomial. Keep promotion provisional so the post-promotion out-of-sample window remains the true arbiter.

detail.name: regime-segment-router
detail.mechanism: Maintain forward edge per (strategy x segment) where segment = {sports/nonsports} x {price-band} x {market-age bucket}. Route alert attention to the best-performing variant WITHIN each live segment rather than one global winner, so a globally-mediocre variant that dominates a niche still gets surfaced there.
detail.edge_source: Pooling across segments hides conditional edges (e.g. longshot may only pay in non-sports niche markets; favorite-tail only in deep-liquidity). The confound discipline is built in by keeping the price-band blind baseline per segment, so a routed segment must beat its own band's blind rate, not the global one.
detail.forward_test: Edge of the routed meta-strategy (pick best variant per live segment) vs the single best GLOBAL variant and vs strict, on held-out resolved signals. Win condition: routed edge > best-global by a margin that survives the per-segment power floor.
detail.confounds: argmax-edge-per-segment over a {sports}×{price-band}×{age} grid of 10 variants is a multiple-comparisons machine: with small n_g the winner is the luckiest variant, and "routed > best-global" is mechanically inflated by that selection. Shrinkage-by-1/n_g and per-band blind baselines do not correct for selecting across many cells.
detail.fix: Pre-register a SMALL fixed segment grid; require each routed cell to clear an explicit power floor AND a multiple-testing correction (FDR/Bonferroni across cells×variants), beat its own-band blind baseline, and be scored strictly walk-forward OOS with the route decided only from signals resolved before each scored signal. Add a stability check (split-half segment-edge agreement) before any cell is allowed to route.

detail.name: correlation-effective-N
detail.mechanism: The 10 variants and their signals are heavily correlated (same markets, overlapping wallets, same events), so naive averaging overstates significance and concentrates drawdown. Build an overlap matrix across concurrently-open signals (shared condition_id, shared event_slug, Jaccard of backer wallets from observed_votes) and compute an effective independent N, then (a) deflate every promotion p-value with clustered standard errors and (b) emit a 'diversified basket' that down-weights signals clustered on the same event/wallet set.
detail.edge_source: Pure honesty/risk-accounting meta-edge: correlated signals masquerade as independent confirmation, inflating both confidence and concentration risk. Correcting effective-N prevents promoting a variant on what is really one correlated event, and prevents correlated drawdown - neither is a market mispricing, both are real edges over the naive portfolio.
detail.forward_test: Realized variance and max drawdown of the equal-weight naive basket vs the cluster-deweighted basket at matched expected edge (the deweighted one should have lower variance for the same mean edge), plus calibration of promotion-gate p-values BEFORE vs AFTER the clustering correction (corrected p-values should be better-calibrated against forward reversion).
detail.confounds: Strongest counter: event-sharing is conflated with informational redundancy. Wallet-Jaccard>0.5 + shared event_slug are treated as double-counting, but multiple wallets converging on one event can be genuine independent confirmation, so 1/cluster_size deweighting risks discarding legitimately strong consensus. Compounded by fragile ρ_intra estimation from few resolved outcomes (mis-estimated ρ over-corrects → type-II under-promotion) and arbitrary Jaccard/threshold knobs.
detail.fix: Score it on the p-value-calibration arm (corrected p-values vs forward reversion), NOT the variance arm which is near-tautological diversification. Estimate ρ_intra from realized outcome correlation among co-open signals rather than assuming wallet-overlap implies redundancy, and validate that the deweighting does not strip a real multi-wallet consensus premium before applying it to the live promotion gate.

detail.name: agreement-of-strategies
detail.mechanism: Treat each of the 10 lever-isolating variants as an independent voter and fire a meta-signal only when >= k of them independently emit a signal on the SAME (condition_id, outcome_index). Forward-track edge as a function of agreement-count k, isolating the robust core where the edge replicates across lever choices and filtering lever-specific overfit.
detail.edge_source: Each variant overfits its own lever (price band, weight mode, freshness); a position that survives ALL lever choices is the robust intersection, less likely to be an artifact of one knob. Edge is not new market info but reduced overfit/model-risk vs any single variant. Explicitly guarded against the trap that the voters are not independent (handled via the effective-N strategy).
detail.forward_test: AVG(outcome_won - entry) per agreement-count bucket, vs strict-alone and vs the band-matched blind baseline. Win condition: high-k (e.g. >=6) edge strictly exceeds strict and survives the power/effective-N gate (note: voters are correlated, so significance must use the correlation-effective-N deflation, not raw vote count).
detail.confounds: agreement_k is collinear with raw consensus strength (same vote pile, monotone-relaxed thresholds) and with market partition membership (longshot vs favorite and sports vs nonsports are DISJOINT voters that can never co-fire). High-k therefore selects the strongest, most-obvious public-leaderboard consensus — precisely the signals most likely already priced (line-prices-public-info), and partly just a relabeled threshold sweep on consensus strength that `strict` already gates on.
detail.fix: Pre-register the test controlling for raw consensus strength (distinct-trader count and net notional): regress realized edge on k with strength held fixed and within price/category partition — count it ONLY if k adds edge BEYOND strength, otherwise it is param_only in disguise. Reframe the win metric to RISK-ADJUSTED (edge per unit variance / drawdown), since ensembling's honest payoff is model-risk reduction, not a higher mean. Exclude mutually-exclusive voters (longshot/favorite, sports/nonsports) from the agreement count or bucket within partition so k measures corroboration, not which bucket the market sits in.

detail.name: thompson-attention-allocator
detail.mechanism: Under the hard minimal-noise push budget (few alerts/day), explicitly allocate the limited alert slots across variants by Thompson sampling: each variant is an arm with a Beta posterior on edge-vs-band-baseline; sample posteriors each cycle and push the top signals from the sampled-best arms, with an exploration floor so early-lucky arms cannot lock out the rest. This is the 'allocate attention to forward-winning variants' mandate done as honest exploration/exploitation.
detail.edge_source: Optimizes which forward-winning variant gets scarce attention without prematurely locking onto a noisy early leader; the exploration floor keeps the promotion-gate statistics fed for every arm. The edge is over a static 'always alert strict' policy and over greedy 'alert current best' - both of which either ignore better niche variants or over-commit to small-sample winners.
detail.forward_test: Cumulative regret vs the oracle best-arm (computed retrospectively on resolved outcomes) and realized edge of pushed signals vs uniform-random allocation across variants over the same budget. Win condition: lower cumulative regret and higher pushed-signal edge than uniform, without starving any arm below its power threshold.
detail.confounds: The strongest counter is the null prior carried over from the foresight arc: if all/most variants are near-zero edge vs baseline (the default expectation until a variant certifies), Thompson sampling optimally allocates scarce attention among indistinguishable zero-edge arms — a perfectly-tuned optimizer over nothing. Cumulative-regret-vs-oracle can look 'good' simply because every arm is equally bad (low regret because there is no best arm to miss), which is not evidence of value.
detail.fix: Reframe it as cheap, harmless infra rather than an edge: (1) use a continuous/Gaussian-reward bandit on the real edge metric instead of Bernoulli win/loss; (2) add time-discounting / sliding window for non-stationarity; (3) gate activation so it only diverges from uniform once an arm crosses a minimum resolved-N power threshold — below that it is provably no worse than uniform, above it the comparison vs uniform-random allocation becomes the honest forward test. Score it only as 'does pushed-signal edge beat uniform once arms are powered', not as a standalone edge.
